blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Proactive assistants that guide people through physical tasks must decide, every few seconds, whether a step is complete and whether a mistake has occurred. We find that two benchmarks for this task largely reward knowing when rather than seeing what: a timer that never looks at the video, raising an alarm at 25 s and confirming each step at 30 s, reaches a mistake F1 of 0.373 on Ego-MC-Bench, above every published result (at most 0.27). We formalize this as the video-blind frontier, the best trade-off between completion accuracy and mistake F1 that policies reach from the elapsed time, the instruction and training statistics alone: every published per-step result on Ego-MC-Bench lies inside it, and so do all twelve zero-shot models we run on QICD. To move beyond it, we introduce Evidence-Contrastive Training (ECT): fine-tune on the benchmark's own questions, and pair its positives with negatives from the same recording at the same elapsed time, so that elapsed time cannot separate the two sides of a pair. Trained on 209 QICD videos in about 15 GPU-hours, a 2B model with ECT crosses the frontier on both benchmarks in all four seeds; transferred to Ego-MC-Bench without adaptation, it confirms 59% of mistake-free steps in time, against 30% for a published model with the same backbone trained on about 25k synthetic counterfactuals and real recordings. Its decisions follow the video beyond what timing explains: at equal elapsed time it tells a finished step from an unfinished one in 90-92% of test pairs, where the instruction's typical duration reaches 65%, rescaling the time stamps between the frames leaves it essentially unchanged, and swapping in another recording, of the same recipe where one exists, cuts its completion accuracy by two thirds. The code and model weights will be publicly released.
blocks.zh: 引导人们完成物理任务的主动助手必须每隔几秒钟决定一个步骤是否完整,是否发生了错误. 我们发现,这一任务的两个基准基本上有利于了解而不是看到什么:一个从不看视频的计时器,在25秒时发出警报,并在30秒时确认每个步骤,在Ego-MC-Bench上的F1误差为0.373,高于每个公布的结果(最多0.27)。 我们把它正式确定为视网膜边疆, 完成精度与错误之间的最佳权衡, 政策从过去的时间, 指令和培训统计本身: Ego-MC-Bench 上每一次公布的结果 都存在于其中, 为了超越它,我们引入了证据-联系训练(ECT):在基准本身的问题上进行微调,并将其正值与同一记录的负值同时配对,这样过去的时间不能将一对的两面分开。 在大约15 GPU小时的209 QICD视频上接受训练,一个带有ECT的2B模型在全部4个种子的两个基准上跨过边界;在没有改编的情况下转移至Ego-MC-Bench,它及时确认了59%的无误步骤,而对于一个在大约25k合成反事实和真实录音方面受过训练的具有相同骨干能力的出版模型来说,30%是无效的. 校对:Soup 代码和模型重量将公开发布.

A policy of elapsed time alone ties the two checks, the zero-shot model ranks them in the wrong order, and ECT ranks them correctly (ECT probabilities average four seeds). The example is the median pair under a fixed selection rule ( Supplement E ).
Across 931 time-matched test pairs, elapsed time alone scores 0.50 by construction (0.65 and 0.54 with the instruction’s typical duration), the zero-shot model scores 0.66 on completion and 0.59 on mistake questions, and ECT scores 0.90–0.92 and 0.75–0.77.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
A proactive assistant watches a person cook, assemble or repair through a head-mounted camera, and must decide every few seconds whether the current step is complete and whether something has gone wrong [ 10 , 11 , 53 , 39 ] .
Speaking at the wrong moment is costly in both directions: a premature “done” sends the person on to a step they are not ready for, and a false alarm interrupts work that was going well—the moment of an interruption changes how much it costs [ 1 ] , and false or repeated alerts make people less likely to act on the next one [ 20 , 3 ] .
The promise of video–language models is that these decisions can be read off the scene.
blocks.zh:
主动助手通过头架摄像机观看一个人的烹饪,组装或修理,必须每隔几秒钟决定当前步骤是否完整,以及是否出了问题[10,11,53,39].
在错误的时刻发言,在两个方向上都是代价高昂的:过早的“done”使此人走上他们尚未准备好的一步,而错误的警报中断了正在顺利进行的工作——中断的时刻改变了它花费多少[1],错误的或反复的警报使人们不太可能在下一个阶段[20,3]采取行动。
视频-语言模型的希望是,这些决定可以在现场宣读。

blocks.en:
We find that one can score well on current benchmarks without reading the scene at all.
Consider a rule that never looks at the video: 25 s into every step it raises an alarm, and at 30 s it declares the step complete.
On Ego-MC-Bench [ 11 ] this rule reaches a mistake F1 of 0.373, above every result reported for the benchmark (at most 0.27).
It confirms no step in time, but such rules trade alarms against confirmations along a whole curve, and with a learned policy on the same inputs they trace a frontier that every reported per-step result lies on or below ( Fig. 2 ; the revised scores of the benchmark paper in Supplement B ).
blocks.zh:
我们发现,在目前的基准上,我们完全可以不读现场。
考虑一个从来不看视频的规则:每一步25秒就会引起警报,30秒它宣布该步骤完成.
在Ego-MC-Bench [11]上,这一规则误差F1为0.373,高于报告的基准结果(最多0.27)。
它没有及时证实任何步骤,但这种规则对沿整个曲线的确认发出警报,并且对同样的投入采取有经验的政策,它们追踪到每个报告的逐步结果都位于或低于(图2;《补编B》基准文件订正分数)。

blocks.en:
We call this curve the video-blind frontier ( Sec. 3 ): the best trade-off between completion accuracy and mistake F1 reached by timing rules and a learned policy that see the elapsed time, the instruction and training-set statistics, but never the frames.
It contains all twelve zero-shot models that we evaluate on the Qualcomm Interactive Cooking dataset (QICD) [ 10 ] , from 2B models to Qwen3.8-Max, and a frontier of the same kind contains the speaking-time results published on GuideMe [ 39 ] .
The clock does not score because elapsed time predicts a single check—its AUROC is 0.52—but because the protocol accepts the first confirmation within a tolerance window, annotations cluster at step boundaries, and the typical duration of each instruction can be learned from the training split.
Models end up inside the frontier because the protocol asks every 5 s and one alarm voids a step: in 83% of the steps in which zero-shot Qwen3-VL-2B raises a false alarm, it does so at the very first check, it and Qwen3.8-Max lose more than half of the mistake-free steps to false alarms, and plainly fine-tuned models confirm steps before they end.
blocks.zh:
我们称这个曲线为视盲边框(sec. 3):在完成精度与时间规则和学习到的政策所达到的错误F1之间的最佳权衡,看过去的时间,教学和训练设定的统计数据,但从不看帧.
它包含所有十二个零镜头模型,我们评价在Qualcomm Interactive Cooking数据集(QICD)[10]上,从2B模型到Quen3.8-Max,同类型的边框包含在GuideMe上发布的演讲时间结果[39].
时钟没有得分,因为过去的时间预示着单次检查——它的AUROC是0.52——但是因为协议接受容忍窗口内的第一个确认,说明分组在阶梯边界上,并且每个指令的典型持续时间可以从训练分割中得知.
模型最终会出现在边界内,因为协议要求每5 s,一个提醒会空出一个步骤:在0发Qwen3-VL-2B引起假警报的步数中,有83%的步数中,它会在最开始的检查中这样做,它和Qwen3.8-Max会失去超过一半的无错步骤来进行假警报,并且明晰的微调模型会在结束前确认步数.

blocks.en:
Both failures happen at moments when time has passed and the evidence has not yet arrived. Evidence-Contrastive Training (ECT, Sec. 4 ) puts these moments into training.
It fine-tunes the model on the protocol’s own checks and pairs positives with negatives from another step of the same recording at the same elapsed time ( Fig. 1 ).
The pair shares the kitchen, the person and the elapsed time, so elapsed time cannot separate its two sides.
blocks.zh:
两次失败都发生在时间已经过去和证据尚未到来的时刻。 取证培训(ECT, Sec. 4)将这些时刻纳入培训。
它微调了协议本身检查的模型,并且从同一记录的同一时间(图1)的另一步对正数和负数配对。
双方共用厨房、个人和经过的时间,因此经过的时间不能分割其两面。

blocks.en:
The recipe is simple; its effect is not.
A 2B model trained with ECT on 209 videos, in about 15 GPU-hours and with neither synthetic data nor a decision threshold, lies beyond the frontier on both benchmarks in all four seeds, and does so on held-out halves of the test set with probability 0.87–0.97 on QICD and 0.99–1.00 on Ego-MC-Bench ( Sec. 5 ).
On Ego-MC-Bench, on which it is never trained, it confirms 59.0% of the mistake-free steps in time, against 30.4% for the same backbone fine-tuned on about 25k synthetic counterfactuals.
Its decisions follow the video beyond what timing explains ( Sec. 6 ).
At equal elapsed time it ranks a finished step above an unfinished one in 90–92% of test pairs, where elapsed time alone scores 50% and the instruction’s typical duration 65%.
Rescaling the time stamps written between the frames leaves it essentially unchanged, but costs the models trained without paired negatives, and a model trained on black frames, much of their separation.
Swapping in another recording, of the same recipe where one exists, drops its completion accuracy from 41.2 to 13.4.
The paired negatives work by cutting the share of checks that raise a false alarm from 18% to 7%, which accounts for most of the gain in completion accuracy.
blocks.zh:
配方很简单;效果并非如此。
一个在209个视频上受过ECT训练的2B模型,在大约15GPU小时的时间里,既没有合成数据,也没有决定阈值,在所有四个种子中都位于两个基准的边界之外,在QICD上的概率为0.87-0.97,Ego-MC-Bench上的概率为0.99-1.00(第5节)的测试中被搁置了一半。
在从未受过训练的Ego-MC-Bench上,它及时确认了59.0%的无错步数,而同一骨干对大约25k合成反事实的微调为30.4%。
其决定遵循的视频超出了时间范围(第6节)。
在同样的时间里,它将超过未完成步骤的一步排在90-92%的测试对中,仅通过时间就得分50%,教学的典型期限为65%。
调整帧间刻制的时间戳,使得其基本不变,但花费了未配对底片而训练的模型,以及一个在黑色帧上训练的模型,它们的大部分分离.
在另一种录音中,如果有同样的食谱,则其完成精度从41.2降至13.4。
配对的负数通过削减将假警报从18%升至7%的检查份额来发挥作用,这占完成准确性的大部分收益.

blocks.en:
Figure 2 : The video-blind frontier contains every published Ego-MC-Bench result and every zero-shot model we run on QICD; ECT lies beyond it on both benchmarks in all four seeds. The gray region is reached by policies that use only the elapsed time, the instruction and training-set statistics: timing rules and a learned policy, both tuned on the test set itself.
Points are scores under the per-step protocol; published points are the 18 per-step results of Ego-MC-Bench v2, and its v3 results also lie inside. On Ego-MC-Bench a single rule (black cross) has higher mistake F1 than every published result, at zero completion accuracy; Qwen3.8-Max is the only zero-shot model beyond the frontier there.
blocks.zh:
图2:视盲边疆区包含每个公布的Ego-MC-Bench结果和我们在QICD上运行的每个零镜头模型;ECT在所有四个种子中都超越它的两个基准. 灰色区域是通过仅仅使用过去时间、教学和培训统计数据的政策达到的:时间规则和学习到的政策,两者都以测试数据本身为导向。
积分是在每步协议下的分数;已公布的积分是Ego-MC-Bench v2的每步18分的结果,其v3的结果也存在于其中. 在Ego-MC-Bench上,一个单规则(黑十字)的错误F1比每个公布的结果要高,以零完成精度;Qune3.8-Max是那里边疆之外唯一的零射击模型.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • A diagnosis and a tool. We show that results on two guidance benchmarks can be matched without the video, formalize this as the video-blind frontier, explain why the clock scores, and recommend reporting this margin. • A simple method. ECT supervises the protocol’s own checks and pairs positives with negatives from the same recording at the same elapsed time, with no synthetic data and no decision threshold. • Evidence. A 2B model trained with ECT lies beyond the frontier on both benchmarks. Time-matched pairs, rescaled time stamps and video swaps show that its decisions follow the video beyond what timing explains, and a replay of its decisions shows that paired negatives work mainly by cutting false alarms at each check.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:诊断和工具。 我们显示,没有录像,两个指导基准的结果可以匹配,将它正式定为视盲边框,解释计时计分的原因,并建议报告这一差值。 一个简单的方法。 ECT监督协议本身的检查,并用同一时间记录的负数配对正数,没有合成数据和决定门槛. • 证据。 在两个基准上,一个受过ECT培训的2B模型位于边界之外。 时间匹配的配对,重新缩放的时间邮票和视频互换显示,其决定跟随视频超越时间解释,对决定的重播显示,配对负数主要通过在每次检查时剪切假警报来工作.

blocks.en: A diagnosis and a tool. We show that results on two guidance benchmarks can be matched without the video, formalize this as the video-blind frontier, explain why the clock scores, and recommend reporting this margin.
blocks.zh: 一个诊断和一个工具。 我们显示,两个指导基准上的结果可以在没有视频的情况下匹配,将它正式定为视盲边框,解释计时计分的原因,并建议报告这一差值.

blocks.en: A simple method. ECT supervises the protocol’s own checks and pairs positives with negatives from the same recording at the same elapsed time, with no synthetic data and no decision threshold.
blocks.zh: 一个简单的方法。 ECT监督协议本身的检查,并用同一时间记录的负数配对正数,没有合成数据和决定门槛.

blocks.en: Evidence. A 2B model trained with ECT lies beyond the frontier on both benchmarks. Time-matched pairs, rescaled time stamps and video swaps show that its decisions follow the video beyond what timing explains, and a replay of its decisions shows that paired negatives work mainly by cutting false alarms at each check.
blocks.zh: 证义曰. 在两个基准上,一个受过ECT培训的2B模型位于边界之外。 时间匹配的配对,重新缩放的时间邮票和视频互换显示,其决定跟随视频超越时间解释,对决定的重播显示,配对负数主要通过在每次检查时剪切假警报来工作.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Building on large egocentric video datasets [ 18 , 25 ] , HoloAssist [ 53 ] recorded instructors guiding people through manual tasks and observed that instructors step in at once for critical mistakes.
QICD [ 10 ] , built on CaptainCook4D [ 41 ] , turned live cooking guidance into a benchmark that scores completion feedback and mistake feedback together; Ego-MC-Bench [ 11 ] added recordings in which a human coach gives feedback in real time, and a model fine-tuned on about 25k synthetic counterfactuals; GuideMe [ 39 ] extends closed-loop guidance to several domains.
Offline, expert feedback can be generated or retrieved for a recorded attempt [ 4 , 5 ] .
We evaluate on the first two under their official protocol and re-read their published results against policies that do not see the video.
blocks.zh:
HoloAssist[53]在大型以自我为中心的视频数据集的基础上,记录了指导人员通过人工操作的任务,并观察到该教官立即介入了重大错误。
基于CaptainCook4D [41]的QICD [10],将现场烹饪指导变成了一个对完成反馈和错误反馈进行评分的基准; Ego-MC-Bench [11] 添加了人类导师实时反馈的录音,以及一个大约25k合成反事实的模型微调; GuideMe [39] 将闭路指导扩展到了多个领域.
离线、专家反馈可生成或检索,以便进行有记录的尝试[4、5]。
我们根据官方协议来评估前两者,

blocks.en:
Streaming video–language models process video as it arrives [ 16 ] and decide at every frame or chunk whether to respond [ 15 , 43 ] ; benchmarks now score the timing of proactive responses [ 55 , 63 ] , and Chatterjee et al. [14] show that protocols that pause to ask hide the cost of late and missing responses.
In several learned systems the decision is governed by a parameter that sets how often the model speaks: a threshold on a silence token [ 15 , 62 , 37 ] , a perplexity gate [ 61 ] , an activation threshold [ 51 ] , or thresholds on dedicated heads and reward weights [ 54 , 56 , 59 ] .
Others decide with a learned gate [ 19 ] , a trained trigger model [ 64 ] or a planning agent [ 60 ] .
Recent assistants tie speaking to the visual state of the task, through an explicit plan [ 33 ] , memory [ 23 ] or learned speak decisions [ 32 , 58 ] , and streaming question answering does so with completion checks [ 26 ] or a readiness head trained with paired moments [ 6 ] ; ProMemAssist [ 42 ] instead times its messages from a model of the user’s working memory.
We share that goal; we add no separate decision module, but change the training distribution so that elapsed time cannot explain the labels, and test whether the resulting timing depends on the video.
blocks.zh:
流传的视频-语言模型在到达时处理视频[16],并在每个帧或块决定是否响应[15,43];基准现在得分是主动响应的时间[55,63],以及Chatterjee等人. [14] 显示暂停询问的协议隐藏延迟和缺失回复的成本.
在一些有学问的系统中,决定由一个参数来决定,该参数规定了模型的表达频率:沉默符上的阈值[15,62,37],迷惑门[61],激活阈值[51],或专用头的阈值和奖励权重[54,56,59].
其他人则用学习的门[19],训练有素的触发模型[64]或规划代理人[60]来决定.
最近一些助手通过明确的计划[33]、记忆[23]或学习过的决定[32,58]来阐述任务的可视性状态,而且通过完成检查[26]或经过对等瞬间训练的准备状态头来回答问题; ProMemAsist[42]比用户工作记忆模型的信息多倍。
我们赞同这个目标;我们没有增加单独的决策单元,但改变培训分发方式,这样过去的时间无法解释标签,并测试由此产生的时间安排是否取决于录像。

blocks.en:
Balanced pairs and changed answer priors exposed language shortcuts in visual question answering [ 24 , 2 ] , and minimal pairs probe compositionality [ 47 ] and visual grounding [ 48 ] ; a single well-chosen frame answers much of video question answering [ 13 ] , many multimodal benchmark items can be answered without the image [ 17 ] , and time-reversed negatives teach models temporal order [ 7 ] .
These works ask whether the answer can be obtained without the intended visual input.
We ask whether the moment to speak can, and because the answer depends on two coupled metrics we give a frontier rather than a single baseline. Umapathi [49] notes that degenerate speaking policies score well on macro-F1.
The closest precedent is PROVIA [ 57 ] , which requires online mistake detectors to beat perception-free controls built from the step index, the elapsed time and priors; we carry this idea over to interactive guidance.
Concurrently, Ben-Ami et al. [9] show with a clock baseline that elapsed time is a shortcut for whether enough evidence has been seen in streaming question answering when negatives are sampled only before the evidence.
We study the sequential protocol of guidance benchmarks, intervene on the video at the level of the model’s decisions, and train a model that moves beyond the frontier.
Our pairs hold the recording and the elapsed time fixed, so the cue they remove is the clock, and we use them both to train the model and to test it.
blocks.zh:
平衡对子和更改的回答在视觉问题回答[24,2]中被曝光的语言快捷键,最小对子探测构成性[47]和视觉地面[48];单个选择的帧解答了许多视频问题回答[13],许多多式联运基准项目可以在没有图像[17]的情况下被解答,时间反转的负数教给模型时间顺序[7].
这些作品询问,没有预定的视觉输入,能否获得答案.
我们问,发言的时刻是否可以,而且因为答案取决于两个结合的衡量标准,我们给出了一个边界,而不是一个单一的基线。 Umapathi[49]指出,退化的言论政策在宏观F1方面得分很高。
最近的先例是PROVIA[57],它要求在线错误探测器击败从步骤索引、过去时间和以前时间中建立的无感知控制;我们把这个想法转到交互式指导。
同时,Ben-Ami et al. [9] 显示一个时钟基线,该时钟基线经过了时间,是当底片只在证据之前取样时,在回答流质问题时是否看到足够证据的捷径.
我们研究指导基准的相继协议,在模型决定的层面上干预视频,并训练一种超越国界的模型。
我们的对子拿着录音和时间 固定,所以他们去掉的提示是时钟, 我们用它们来训练和测试模型。

blocks.en:
A separate line of work builds datasets of mistakes in recorded procedures [ 45 , 41 , 34 , 28 ] and detects or attributes them, offline [ 31 , 27 , 38 , 40 ] or online [ 22 , 44 ] , surveyed by Li et al. [36] . Spurio et al. [46] post-train a vision–language model on pairs with the same step description and opposite evidence, for offline detection.
These methods score segments or actions; none is evaluated on confirming completion and flagging mistakes together under a given instruction, where every alarm is weighed against a confirmation.
blocks.zh:
单独一行的工作建立记录程序中错误的数据集[45,41,34,28],并将其检测或属性,离线[31,27,38,40]或在线[22,44],由李等人调查. [36] (中文(简体) ). Spurio 等人[46] 进行线下检测时,在有相同步骤描述和相反证据的对子上安装一个视觉-语言模型。
这些方法得分部分或动作;在确认完成和在某一指示下标出错误时,没有评估任何部分或动作。

blocks.en: 3 Do the benchmarks reward seeing? The video-blind frontier
blocks.zh: 3个 这些基准能奖励人们吗? 视盲边疆

blocks.en: On the two benchmarks we study, most reported scores can be reached without looking at the video.
blocks.zh: 在我们研究的两个基准上,大多数报告得分可以不看视频就能达到.

blocks.en:
We use the official per-step protocol of QICD [ 10 ] and Ego-MC-Bench [ 11 ] .
On QICD we use the Advanced Planning set, where the two decisions constrain each other most: its test split contains only recordings that deviate from the plan, and half of its steps contain a mistake.
The model is given the current step’s instruction, and the input window is anchored at that step’s annotated start. Only a model confirmation advances the instruction; if a step is never confirmed, later steps are not reached ( Supplement A ).
Every 5 s it receives the frames observed since the step began (at most 240) and is asked, with the official prompts and greedy decoding, whether the step is complete and, if not, whether a mistake has occurred; an answer is positive under the official parsing rule (it contains “yes”).
We call each such query a check .
In this protocol, “zero-shot Qwen3-VL-2B” denotes the stronger of its two variants, with the memory prompt of Bhattacharyya et al. [11] , unless stated otherwise. Completion accuracy (IC-Acc) is the share of mistake-free steps whose completion is confirmed within 15 s of the annotated step end; any mistake feedback issued during such a step voids it. Mistake F1 matches mistake feedback to annotated mistakes with the same ± \pm 15 s tolerance.
The two metrics are coupled: every alarm can void a step that would otherwise count, and a model that never raises an alarm protects its completion accuracy at a mistake F1 of zero.
Neither number can be read alone.

blocks.en:
A video-blind policy decides when to confirm and when to raise an alarm from the time elapsed since the step began, the step index, the instruction text and statistics of the training split, and never from the frames.
We consider three families of rules: fixed delays (confirm completion A A seconds into every step, raise one alarm at B B seconds); confirmation at a multiple of the typical duration of the same instruction in the training split; and alarms only for instructions that often go wrong in the training split.
We add a learned policy on the same inputs: gradient-boosted trees fit on the QICD training and validation splits predict each step’s duration and mistake probability, and a grid of policies confirms and alarms at multiples of the predicted duration.
We run every rule, per-step mixtures of rules and every learned policy through the official scorer, and define the video-blind frontier as the upper convex hull of the resulting (IC-Acc, F1) points ( Fig. 2 ).
The margin Δ \Delta of a result is its mistake F1 minus the frontier’s F1 at the same or a higher IC-Acc; a negative margin means that a blind policy does at least as well on both metrics.
To favor the blind policies, we tune them on the test set itself. 1 1 1 Every vertex of the hull is a measured policy; between vertices we interpolate, which credits blind policies with trade-offs we did not run. Above the highest IC-Acc of any blind policy (51.7 on QICD, 56.1 on Ego-MC-Bench) the frontier is zero.
blocks.zh:
视盲政策决定何时确认,何时发出警报,从该步骤开始后的时间算起,该步骤索引,指令文本和训练统计分开,从不从框架划分.
我们考虑三条规则:固定延迟(确认每一步A秒完成,B秒发出一个警报);在训练分裂中同一指示的典型持续时间的倍数上确认;以及只针对训练分裂中经常出错的指示发出警报.
我们补充了一项关于相同投入的有学问的政策:在QICD训练和验证上植入梯度的树,它们会预测每个步骤的持续时间和误差概率,一系列政策会确认并提醒预测持续时间的倍数。
我们通过官方计分器运行每条规则,每步规则的混合物和每条学到的政策,并将视频盲边定义为结果(IC-Acc,F1)积分(图2)的上层对流船体.
结果的差值为F1乘以相同或更高的IC-Acc的F1;负差值意味着盲目政策至少在两种衡量标准上都一样。
为了支持盲目政策,我们把政策调整到测试中。 1,11,船体的每个顶点都是量度政策;在顶点之间,我们进行插值,将盲点政策与我们没有进行的权衡相抵. 在任何盲目的政策中最高的IC-Acc(QICD上的51.7,Ego-MC-Bench上的56.1)之上,边疆为零.

blocks.en:
A single rule—raise an alarm 25 s into every step and confirm completion at 30 s—reaches a mistake F1 of 0.373 on Ego-MC-Bench, above every reported result (at most 0.27); with its two delays chosen on the QICD validation split instead, it still reaches 0.361.
This rule confirms no step in time, which is why the comparison is made along the frontier.
None of the 18 per-step results in Tables 2 and 3 of Ego-MC-Bench [ 11 ] lies beyond the frontier, in either version of that paper ( Supplement B ); the result with the highest mistake F1 (33.0 / 0.27, fine-tuned Qwen3.5-2B in v3) has Δ = − 0.054 \Delta=-0.054 .
The pattern is not specific to these benchmarks: on the speaking-time metrics of GuideMe [ 39 ] , all 13 results of the main table lie inside or on a frontier built from blind timing rules, and never speaking matches or exceeds 11 of them ( Supplement B ).

Under the same protocol, all twelve zero-shot models that we run on QICD lie inside the frontier ( Fig. 2 , Tab. 1 ): six models with 2B to 8B parameters from three families, four sizes of Qwen3.5 from 27B to 397B, and two Qwen3.8 models.
Larger models are not reliably better here (the Qwen3.5 and Qwen3.8 models are given 16 frames per check), and most of the small models never raise an alarm.
On Ego-MC-Bench only Qwen3.8-Max crosses the frontier (37.9 / 0.324, Δ = + 0.025 \Delta=+0.025 ).

更大的模型在这里并不可靠地更好(Quen3.5和Quen3.8模型每检查一次得到16帧),大多数小模型从不发出警报.

blocks.en:
The reason is not that elapsed time predicts the answer to an individual check: over the checks of the QICD test set its area under the ROC curve (AUROC) is about 0.52 for either question.
The clock scores because the protocol is sequential.
The first confirmation ends a step and is accepted within ± \pm 15 s, so a rule only has to choose when to speak first, not to be right at every check.
And the annotations sit where a clock can find them: 91% of the mistake feedback in QICD is annotated exactly at the end of the step.
Where recipes repeat, as in QICD, the training split adds the typical duration of each instruction: relative to it, elapsed time separates completions at an AUROC of 0.61, a signal that fine-tuning on the protocol’s checks can pick up. On Ego-MC-Bench only 2 of 562 instructions occur in the training split ( Supplement B ).
blocks.zh:
原因不是时间过长预示了对单项检查的答案:在对QICD测试的检查中,在ROC曲线(AUROC)下设定的面积对两个问题都约为0.52.
计时计分因为协议是顺序的.
第一个确认结束一个步骤,并在 ±\pm 15 s 内被接受,因此一个规则只需要选择何时先发言,而不是在每次检查时正确.
而注解则坐落在一个时钟能找到它们的地方:QICD中91%的错误反馈完全在步骤的结尾处附加注解.
在食谱重复时,如QICD一样,培训的划分会增加每个教学的典型期限:相对于它,经过的时间在0.61的AUROC中分离完成,这个信号可以对协议的检查进行微调。 在Ego-MC-Bench中,在培训分拆中只收到562项指示中的2项(补编B)。

blocks.en:
Decomposing each model’s decisions on mistake-free steps by their outcome under the official scorer, in the spirit of TIDE [ 12 ] , shows two failure modes ( Fig. 3 ).
Some models raise alarms without evidence : a false alarm voids 56.3% of the mistake-free steps for zero-shot Qwen3-VL-2B and 52.9% for Qwen3.8-Max. Because the protocol asks every 5 s and a single alarm voids the step, a modest rate per check becomes a large loss per step; the zero-shot 2B model raises its first false alarm at the very first check in 83% of the steps it voids.
Others confirm too early : after plain fine-tuning on the QICD training split, Qwen3-VL-2B never raises an alarm and confirms 34.5% of the mistake-free steps before they end.
Both failures happen at moments when time has passed but the evidence has not arrived; Sec. 4 puts exactly these moments into training.
blocks.zh:
按照TIDE[12]的精神,按官方计分器下的结果来解析每个模型关于无错误步骤的决定,显示了两种失败模式(图3).
一些型号在无证据的情况下发出警报:假警报为零发Qwen3-VL-2B的无误步骤的56.3%,为Qwen3.8-Max的52.9%. 因为协议要求每5s,一个警报会使步骤无效,所以每检查一个微小的速率就成为每步很大的损失;零射2B模型在它空出的步数的83%的第一检查时,会提出它的第一个假警报.
其他人则确认太早:在QICD训练分拆后,Qune3-VL-2B从不发出警报,并在结束前确认34.5%的无错误步骤.
两次失败都发生在时间已经过去但证据尚未到来的时刻;第4条正是将这些时刻付诸训练。

blocks.en:
Because the two metrics are coupled, either one alone can be raised by a rule that does not look at the video.
We recommend reporting the margin Δ \Delta over the video-blind frontier alongside results on these benchmarks; Supplement B lists its vertices.

blocks.en: 4 Evidence-Contrastive Training
blocks.zh: 4. 取证培训

blocks.en:
Both failures in Sec. 3 occur at moments when time has passed and the evidence has not arrived.
Evidence-Contrastive Training (ECT) puts these moments into training.
It has two ingredients: each training example is a check of the benchmark protocol, and positives are paired with negatives at the same elapsed time.
blocks.zh:
第3节中的两次失败都发生在时间已经过去而证据尚未到来的时刻。
取证培训(ECT)将这些时刻纳入培训。
它有两个成份:每个训练实例都是对基准协议的检查,阳性值与阴性值在同一时间对齐.

blocks.en:
Every training example is one check of the protocol, which we call a situation : the frames since the step began, the official prompt, and the answer.
From the QICD annotations we take mistake situations at the annotated feedback time and 5 and 10 s later, answered “YES” followed by the feedback, and success situations at the step end and 5 s later, answered “YES”.
Checks at which nothing should be said are answered “NO”; these include checks placed before an annotated mistake, outside its tolerance window.
During training, situations are sampled by kind with fixed weights ( Supplement J ).
blocks.zh:
每个训练例子都是对协议的一个检查,我们称之为情况:步骤开始后的帧,官方的提示,以及答案。
从 " QICD " 说明中,我们在附加说明的反馈时间出现错误情况,5和10s在后面回答 " YES " ,然后是反馈,5s在步骤结束时回答 " YES " 。
回答“否”的检查,包括在附加说明的错误之前,在容忍窗口之外进行的检查。
在培训期间,以固定重量对情况进行抽样(补编J)。

blocks.en:
For a positive at elapsed time E E , ECT looks for a negative from another step of the same recording at the same E E ( Fig. 1 shows one such pair); we call these paired negatives .
A notdone negative pairs a success situation with a step that still has at least 20 s to run, and answers “NO” to the completion question; it targets early confirmation.
A clean negative pairs a mistake situation with a mistake-free step that still has at least 15 s to run, and answers “NO” to the mistake question; it targets alarms without evidence.
Not every positive has such a partner in its recording: we obtain 4,068 notdone negatives for 4,563 success situations and 1,159 clean negatives for 1,938 mistake situations.

一个不记名的负对子以一个至少还有20秒要运行的步骤成功,并且回答完成问题的“否”;它的目标是早日确认。

blocks.en:
Because both sides come from one recording, the kitchen, the person and the camera are shared; because the elapsed time is equal, so are the window length and the clock reading.
Within a pair, any policy that reads only the elapsed time or the window length must give both sides the same answer; the instruction can still differ, and with it the step’s typical duration.
Pooled over all positives and their paired negatives, elapsed time separates the labels with an AUROC of 0.541 for the completion question and 0.606 for the mistake question, since not every positive has a partner.
blocks.zh:

在一对内,任何只读过的时间或窗口长度的政策都必须给双方一个相同的答案;指令仍然可以不同,因此步骤的典型持续时间也不同。
在所有阳性及其配对阴性之间,经过一段时间后,标签与完成问题为0.541的AUROC和错误问题为0.606的AUROC分开,因为并不是每个阳性者都有伴侣。

blocks.en:
We fine-tune Qwen3-VL-2B [ 8 ] with rank-64 LoRA [ 30 ] for 2,400 steps, about one epoch over the roughly 18,400 situations built from the 209 training videos, with cross-entropy on the answer tokens; this takes about 15 GPU-hours on a single A100-40G.
At test time the model is run exactly as in Sec. 3 : the official prompts and greedy decoding.
ECT uses no decision threshold and no synthetic data.

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en:
ECT is trained on the 209 training videos of QICD Advanced Planning and evaluated on its 36 test videos and, without any adaptation, on the 39 available videos of Ego-MC-Bench.
The two benchmarks are complementary: in QICD mistake feedback is almost always annotated at the end of a step, whereas in Ego-MC-Bench a human coach gives it while the step is under way (4% at the step end).
Each test configuration is run once.
We train four seeds, report the mean and standard deviation over seeds, and test differences with a paired bootstrap over videos [ 21 ] and Holm correction [ 29 ] .
blocks.zh:
ECT接受了QICD高级规划的209个培训视频的培训,并接受了其36个测试视频的评价,以及没有任何修改的Ego-MC-Bench的39个可用视频的评价.
这两个基准是相辅相成的:在QICD中,错误反馈几乎总是在一步结束时附加注释,而在Ego-MC-Bench中,在步骤进行期间,人类教练给予错误反馈(步骤结束时为4%)。
每个测试配置运行一次.
我们训练4个种子,报告种子的平均值和标准偏差,测试差异,在视频[21]和霍尔姆校正[29]上配对的靴子。

blocks.en:
All four seeds lie beyond the video-blind frontier on both benchmarks ( Tab. 1 , Fig. 2 ).
On QICD, ECT reaches 40.8 ± 1.3 40.8\pm 1.3 IC-Acc and 0.247 ± 0.033 0.247\pm 0.033 mistake F1, with margins from + 0.012 +0.012 to + 0.061 +0.061 ; on Ego-MC-Bench, on which it is never trained, 59.0 ± 5.7 59.0\pm 5.7 and 0.246 ± 0.034 0.246\pm 0.034 , with margins from + 0.17 +0.17 to + 0.28 +0.28 .
Two of the Ego-MC-Bench seeds exceed the completion accuracy of every blind policy, where the frontier is zero; the other two have margins of + 0.169 +0.169 and + 0.259 +0.259 against a non-zero frontier.
The pre-registered variant with decision thresholds chosen on validation data is also beyond the frontier in every seed ( Tab. 1 ).
When the blind policies are tuned on one half of the test videos and the margin is measured on the other, a seed lies beyond the frontier in 87–97% of 500 splits on QICD and 99–100% on Ego-MC-Bench ( Supplement B ).
blocks.zh:
所有四种种子都位于两个基准的视盲边界之外(图1,图2)。
在QICD上,ECT达到40.8±1.3 40.8\pm 1.3 IC-ACC和0.247±0.033 0.247\pm 0.033错F1,差值从+0.012 + 0.012 + 0.061 + 0.061 + 0.061;在Ego-MC-Bench上,它从未受过训练,59.0±5.7 59.0\pm 5.7和0.246±0.034 0.246\pm 0.034,差值从+0.17+0.17 到+0.28+0.28.
Ego-MC-Bench种子中有两颗超过每颗盲政策的完成精度,其中边框为0;另外两颗的边框为+0.169+0.169和+0.259+0.259对非零边框.
在每种种子中,预先登记的具有在验证数据上选择的决定阈值的变体也超出了边界范围(附件1)。
当盲目政策被调用到一半的测试视频上,而比值则被测量到另一半时,一个种子在QICD上的500分中的87-97%和Ego-MC-Bench上的99-100%(补充B)就位于边界之外。

blocks.en:
The reported Qwen3-VL-2B fine-tuned on about 25k synthetic counterfactual pairs mixed with QICD and Goal-Step reaches 30.4 / 0.16 (0.20 in the revised version), and a reported Qwen3.5-2B trained on QICD alone reaches 28.9 / 0.10 [ 11 ] .
ECT uses 209 QICD videos and 2,400 steps on one A100, versus about 100k iterations on eight H100 GPUs for the reported same-backbone model. ECT reaches 59.0 / 0.246 on 39 released sessions; the published scores above use 40 sessions.
Our fine-tuning without paired negatives already reaches 48.3 / 0.337; adding the negatives raises completion accuracy but lowers mistake F1 ( Tab. 1 ).
QICD Advanced Planning has no published result under the per-step protocol, so on that benchmark we compare with blind policies and zero-shot models.
blocks.zh:
报告的Qwen3-VL-2B对与QICD和Goal-Step混合的约25k合成反事实配对进行了微调,达到30.4/0.16(修订版中为0.20),报告的Quen3.5-2B仅接受QICD培训的单次达到28.9/0.10[11].
ECT在一台A100上使用209 QICD视频和2400步,相对于8台H100 GPU上的约100k迭代,用于报道的同一背骨模型. ECT在39期发布会上达到59.0/0.246;以上发布的分数使用40期.
我们的不配对负数的微调已经达到48.3 / 0. 337;加上负数提高完成精度但降低误差F1(Tab. 1).
QICD 数据 高级规划在每步协议下没有公布结果,所以在这个基准上,我们与盲目政策和零镜头模型进行比较.

blocks.en:
Against the same model zero-shot, ECT raises completion accuracy from 10.5 to 40.8 on QICD and from 14.4 to 59.0 on Ego-MC-Bench (significant for every seed tested); the gain in mistake F1 is significant for two of the four seeds on QICD and not on Ego-MC-Bench (0.246 against 0.215), where 0.43 of its alarms are correct, against 0.20 zero-shot and 0.32 for Qwen3.8-Max.
Qwen3.8-Max crosses the frontier on one benchmark, by + 0.025 +0.025 ; the 2B model with ECT crosses on both and reaches 40.8% IC-Acc on QICD, against 23.9% for Qwen3.8-Max.
blocks.zh:
对照同一型号的零射线,ECT将完成精度从QICD上的10.5升至40.8,Ego-MC-Bench上的14.4升至59.0(每个种子都测试过);错误中F1的增益对QICD上的4个种子中有2个是显著的,而不是Ego-MC-Bench上的增益(0.246对0.215),其警报的0.43正确,对0.20零射线和0.32对Qune3.8-Max.
Qwen3.8-Max在一个基准上跨过边界,以+0.025+0.025;带有ECT的2B模型在两者上交叉,在QICD上达到40.8%的IC-Acc,而在Qwen3.8-Max上则达到23.9%.

blocks.en:
The same recipe moves InternVL3.5-2B [ 52 ] (32.8 / 0 zero-shot to 47.9 / 0.256) and LLaVA-OneVision-7B [ 35 ] (0 / 0 to 49.6 / 0.171) beyond the frontier on QICD.
On Ego-MC-Bench both reach 64.0 IC-Acc, above every blind policy (56.1), but their mistake recall is only 0.05–0.07, so across backbones we claim only the gain in completion accuracy.
The same recipe also puts one Qwen3-VL-4B seed beyond the frontier on both benchmarks (40.3 / 0.227 and 61.7 / 0.175), without a consistent improvement over the 2B model across both metrics.
Results with smaller training subsets are in Supplement C .
blocks.zh:
同样的食谱将InternVL3.5-2B [52](32.8 / 0 零射入47.9 / 0.256)和LLaVA-One Vision-7B [35](0 / 0 / 49.6 / 0.171)移动到QICD上的边界之外.
在Ego-MC-Bench上,两者都达到了64.0 IC-Acc, 高于每一个盲目政策(56.1), 但他们的错误回忆只有0.05–0.07, 因此,在骨干上,我们只声称在完成准确性方面有所收获。
同样的配方还使两个基准(40.3/0.227和61.7/0.175)上一个超过边界的Qwen3-VL-4B种子,但没有在两个指标上与2B模型相比得到持续改进。
培训子集较小的成果载于补编C。

blocks.en:
Our diagnosis concerns the per-step protocol: in the streaming setting of the reported QICD Advanced Planning results, without the annotated step-start anchors, blind rules are weak because their errors accumulate. The four seeds reach an IC-Acc of 16.4–22.3 ( Supplement C ) against 12.6 for LiveMamba [ 10 ] , whose mistake F1 (0.19) is higher than ours (0.13–0.18) and whose training data differ.
On the Main set of QICD, where two published systems lie beyond the frontier [ 10 , 50 ] , all four greedy ECT seeds do so without tuning on that set, with margins of + 0.072 +0.072 to + 0.143 +0.143 ( Supplement C ).
blocks.zh:
我们的诊断涉及到每步协议:在所报道的QICD高级规划结果的流畅设置中,没有附加说明的步骤启动锚点,盲规则因为其错误累积而软弱无力. 这四种种子达到16.4–22.3的IC-ACC(补充C)与12.6的LiveMamba [10],其错误的F1(0.19)高于我们的(0.13–0.18),其训练数据不同.
在QICD主集上,两个公布的系统都位于边疆之外[10,50],所有4个贪婪的ECT种子都这样做时没有在该集上调音,边距为+0.072+0.072到+0.143+0.143(补编第C号).

blocks.en: 6 Does the model wait for evidence?
blocks.zh: 6个 模特儿在等证据吗?

blocks.en: Where elapsed time is held fixed, ECT decides by the video well beyond what the instruction’s typical duration explains, and it does not respond to the time stamps between the frames. Paired negatives get it there mainly by cutting false alarms at each check.
blocks.zh: 如果所持时间固定,则电算中心通过录像来决定远远超出指示的典型期限,它不会对框之间的时间戳作出反应。 Paired底片主要通过在每次检查时剪断假警报得到.

blocks.en:
We replace each test video with another recording, of the same recipe wherever one exists, keeping the instructions, the step boundaries and the timing.
A model that follows the clock would not notice.
For seed 0 on the test set, completion accuracy falls from 41.2 to 13.4 and mistake F1 from 0.217 to 0.094. On the validation split, completion accuracy falls from 47.2 to 14.7 ( Supplement H ).
On that validation split, shuffling the frames costs 10 completion points, and repeating only the last frame reduces completion accuracy to 0.7.
On black frames ECT says nothing at all, while the same fine-tuning without paired negatives still raises 109 false alarms.
The way it fails changes too ( Fig. 3 , last row): the share of steps voided by a false alarm falls from 27% to 19%, while late confirmations rise from 12% to 28% and a further 21% of the steps are never confirmed or never reached.
Deprived of evidence, the model waits ( Fig. 4 ).
blocks.zh:
我们用另一段录制来取代每段测试录像, 无论何处有相同的食谱,
遵循时钟的模型不会注意到.
对于测试组上的0号种子,完成精度从41.2降至13.4,错误F1从0.217降至0.094. 在验证分拆时,完成精度从47.2降至14.7(补编H.)。
在该验证分拆时,拆卸帧需要10个完成点,而只重复最后一个完成点则将完成精度降低到0.7.
在黑框ECT上完全没说,而同样的没有配对底片的微调仍然引起109个假警报.
它的失败方式也发生了变化(图3,最后一行):被假警报取消的步数比例从27%下降到19%,而迟到的确认率从12%上升到28%,还有21%的步数从未确认或从未达到。
缺少证据,模型等待(图4).

blocks.en:
Figure 4 : Without the matching video, ECT waits. A mistake-free QICD test step under the original recording (top) and under another recording of the same recipe at the same frame indices (bottom); instruction and clock are unchanged.
ECT confirms the step on time in the original and 129 s late in the swap, without raising an alarm. Gray: the ± \pm 15 s tolerance around the step end.
The step is one of the seven nearest the median duration among the 28 test steps that seed 0 confirms on time and, after the swap, neither flags nor confirms within tolerance ( Supplement H ).
blocks.zh:
图4:没有匹配的视频,ECT等待. 在原始录制(上)下以及在同一帧指数(下)下同一食谱的另一录制下,一个无错误的QICD测试步骤;指令和时钟不变.
ECT在原作中及时确认台阶,在互换中迟到129次,没有引起警报. Gray: ±\pm 15 围绕步端的耐力.
该步骤是0号种子及时确认的28个测试步骤中最接近中位数的7个步骤之一,在互换后,既不悬挂旗帜,也不确认耐受性(补编H)。

blocks.en:
Table 2: What each ingredient changes. All rows fine-tune Qwen3-VL-2B and use greedy decoding; means over n n training seeds. Δ \Delta : margin over the video-blind frontier. Void / Early: share (%) of mistake-free steps voided by a false alarm / confirmed too early. Pair: accuracy on time-matched mistake pairs (0.50 for any policy of elapsed time alone).
ECT is to be compared with “No paired neg.”, which differs from it in the negatives alone. ∗ Two seeds on Ego-MC-Bench. ‡ An earlier recipe that also differs in how situations are placed and sampled ( Supplement J ); it never raises an alarm. § ECT with negatives drawn at random moments of the same steps; same-seed comparisons, including Ego-MC-Bench, are in Supplement C .
blocks.zh:
表2:每种成分的变化。 所有行均微调Qwen3-VL-2B,并使用贪婪的解码;表示n训练种子以上. (原始内容存档于2018-09-27). QQ/Delta:悬空过视盲边疆. Void / Early: 由错误的提醒而无效的无错误步骤的共享(%) / 确认得太早. 平价:按时间比对的误差对数的准确性(仅任何过期时间的政策,0.50)。
ECT与“无配对neg.”作比较,后者与负数不同。 * Ego-MC-Bench上的两个种子。 更早的配方在如何放置和取样方面也有所不同(补编J);它从未引起过警示。 §ECT带有在相同步骤的随机瞬间抽取的负数;包括Ego-MC-Bench在内的同种种子比较载于补编C。

blocks.en:
A swap changes the video and can also change its alignment with the instruction.
To test whether elapsed time alone explains the decisions, we build 931 pairs from the QICD test videos as in ECT’s negative sampling: two checks from the same recording, at the same elapsed time and with the same window length to within one frame in 928 pairs (the other three are cut short by the end of the video). They ask the same question with opposite answers, but the step instructions can differ.
We measure how often a model gives the higher probability of “yes” to the correct side; any policy of elapsed time alone scores exactly 0.5, and one that also uses the instruction’s typical duration in the training split scores 0.65 on completion and 0.54 on mistake pairs, because the two steps of a pair usually differ.
Zero-shot Qwen3-VL-2B (a single check, so without the memory prompt) scores 0.66 on completion pairs and 0.59 on mistake pairs; ECT scores 0.90–0.92 and 0.75–0.77 over four seeds ( Supplement E ).
The three models fine-tuned without paired negatives (two seeds and the re-balanced variant of Tab. 2 ) reach 0.63–0.67 on mistake pairs: the negatives add + 0.104 +0.104 (95% CI [ + 0.044 , + 0.156 ] [+0.044,+0.156] , paired bootstrap over videos) and cut the rate of answering “yes” on the side without evidence from 23–32% to 4–8%.
The gain carries over to InternVL3.5-2B (0.72 against 0.67), and LLaVA-OneVision-7B with ECT reaches 0.75.
On completion pairs every fine-tuned variant scores 0.87–0.92: supervising the protocol’s checks already teaches the model to see that a step is finished.
blocks.zh:
互换可以改变视频,也可以改变其与指令的对齐.
为了检验是否仅用时间来解释这些决定, 我们从QICD测试视频中构建931对, 如ECT的负面采样: 从同一录制中, 他们用相反的答案提出同样的问题,但步骤指示可能有所不同.
我们衡量一个模型给正确一方“是”的概率有多高;任何单是时间过长就得0.5分的政策,以及一个在训练中也使用该指示的典型期限的分数在完成时分0.65分,错对时分0.54分,因为一对的两步通常不同。
0射门Qwen3-VL-2B(单次检查,因此没有内存提示)在完成对分时得分0.66分,在错对分时得分0.59分;ECT在4个种子中得分0.90–0.92分和0.75–0.77分(补充E.
三种没有配对负数的模型(两个种子和Tab 2的复平衡变体)在错对上达到0.63–0.67:负数加+0.104+0.104(95% CI [+0.044,+0.156] [+0.044,+0.156],配对的靴子在视频上),将侧面的回答"赞成"率从23–32%降至4–8%.
收益结转到INNVL3.5-2B(0.72对0.67)和LLaVA-One Vision-7B的ECT达到0.75.
完成对齐时,每个微调的变体得分为0.87-0.92:监督协议的检查已经教给模型看一个步骤已经完成。

blocks.en:
Qwen3-VL writes a time stamp between the frames of a window. On 411 fixed validation checks we doubled or halved every stamp, keeping the pixels, the number of frames and the prompt ( Supplement H ).
ECT (seed 0) is unaffected: its AUROC is 0.945, 0.942 and 0.943 for completion and 0.841, 0.820 and 0.846 for mistakes with the original, doubled and halved stamps.
Without paired negatives, the same check separates mistakes from silence at 0.971 with the original stamps and 0.79–0.80 with rescaled ones, no longer above ECT; both rescalings raise its probability of “yes” on silent checks, so it reacts to unfamiliar stamps rather than reading their value. After plain fine-tuning the separation drops from 0.961 to 0.60–0.61.
The ECT recipe trained on black frames separates completions at 0.920 without any video, and 0.74–0.77 once the stamps are rescaled.
ECT still uses how long a step usually takes, as a coach would: its confirmation times follow the median training duration of the instruction, a cue its training pairs leave in place. At equal elapsed time, though, it scores 0.90–0.92 on the pairs where this cue reaches 0.65 and the black-frame model 0.62–0.64.
blocks.zh:
Quen3-VL在窗口框架之间写一个时间戳. 在411个固定的验证检查中,我们把每个印章翻了一番或减半,保留了像素,帧数和及时(补充H.
ECT(种子0)不受影响:其AUROC为0.945,0.942和0.943完成,0.841,0.820和0.846为有差错的原邮票,加倍和减半的邮票.
不配对底片,同一支票将错误与沉默区分开来:0.971与原邮票,0.79–0.80与重制邮票,不再高于ECT;两种缩放都提高了它在无声支票上"是"的概率,因此它对不熟悉邮票的反应而不是读取其价值. 经过纯度微调后,分离从0.961降至0.60–0.61.
接受过黑框训练的ECT食谱将完成量分为0.920,没有录像,邮票调整后则分为0.74–0.77。
ECT仍然使用一个步骤通常需要多长时间,如导师会:它的确认时间遵循教学的中位数训练时间,一个提示它的训练对就位. 不过,在相同时间里,它得分是0.90-0.92的对子,即这个提示达到0.65,黑框型号为0.62-0.64。

blocks.en:
Fine-tuning on the protocol’s checks improves completion accuracy; the paired negatives change the balance between confirmations and alarms ( Tab. 2 ).
Fine-tuning without paired negatives already puts the model beyond the frontier on Ego-MC-Bench ( Δ = + 0.139 \Delta=+0.139 ); on QICD it stays inside ( Δ = − 0.066 \Delta=-0.066 ).
It gets there by raising alarms without evidence: 48% of the mistake-free steps are voided, with 1.3–1.5 false alarms per mistake-free step (0.5–0.6 for ECT), and completion accuracy on QICD is 26.5.
Clean negatives halve the voided steps (25%) and lift completion accuracy to 43.3, with the largest margin on QICD.
Re-balancing the answers by sampling, instead of adding negatives, keeps the completion accuracy low and the false alarms in place.
blocks.zh:
对协议的检查进行精细调整可以提高完成的准确性;配对的负数会改变确认和提醒之间的平衡(Tab. 2 )。
不配对负数的微调已经使模型在Ego-MC-Bench(= + 0.139\Delta= 0.139)上超越边界;在QICD(= = − 0.066\Delta=- 0.066)上停留.
它通过无证据的警报到达那里:48%的无错误步骤是无效的,每个无错误步骤有1.3–1.5的假警报(ECT为0.5–0.6),QICD上的完成精度为26.5.
清洁负数将已失效的步数(25%)减半,并将完成精度提高到43.3,在QICD上比值最大.
通过采样重新平衡答案,而不是增加负数,使完成精度低,假警报到位.

blocks.en:
Notdone negatives make the confirmation follow the progress of the step: on the unseen steps of Ego-MC-Bench its correlation with the step’s duration is 0.45–0.69 for the variants trained with them (0.68 with notdone negatives alone), 0.30–0.40 for those without and 0.10 for the zero-shot model, and fewer mistake-free steps are confirmed more than 15 s early (37–55 against 62–82; Supplement C ).
Relative to no paired negatives, using both kinds reduces early confirmation from 18% to 13% on QICD and from 25% to 16% on Ego-MC-Bench, where IC-Acc rises from 48.3 to 59.0.
blocks.zh:
Notdone 负数使确认跟随该步骤的进展:在Ego-MC-Bench的隐形步骤上,它与该步骤持续时间的关联性是:用它训练的变体为0.45-0.69(仅用nodone 负数为0.68),没有这种变体为0.30-0.40,零射线模型为0.10,零射线模型为0.10,早期确认的无误步骤少于15(37-55对62-82;补编C)。
相对于无配对负数,使用这两种类型,在QICD上将早期确认率从18%降至13%,在Ego-MC-Bench上将提前确认率从25%降至16%,其中IC-Acc从48.3升至59.0.

blocks.en: Negatives drawn at random moments of the same steps also put both tested seeds beyond the frontier on both benchmarks: within a recording the clock separates them from the positives about as poorly as matched ones (AUROC 0.555–0.561 and 0.607–0.620, against 0.541 and 0.606), and they shift the trade-off between the two metrics ( Supplement C ).
blocks.zh: 在相同步骤的随机瞬间得出的负数也使两种试验种子都超越了两个基准:在记录的时钟中,它们与对应的正数(AUROC 0.555-0.561和0.607-0.620,与0.541和0.606)相差无几,它们将两个衡量标准之间的权衡转移(补编C)。

blocks.en:
For ECT and the variant without paired negatives (seed 0 of each), we logged both probabilities at every check of the QICD test set and replayed the official protocol offline; at the thresholds of the pre-registered decoding the replay matches the official IC-Acc of both runs (42.0 and 31.1), counting the few steps that outlast the log as confirmed at the next check ( Supplement F ).
Over the checks of mistake-free steps, 7.3% raise a false alarm for ECT and 18.3% for the variant, and 26.5% and 40.8% of these steps are voided.
Giving the variant the mistake probabilities of ECT, with its own completion probabilities, raises its IC-Acc from 31.1 to 40.8, close to the 42.0 of ECT (23.1 to 38.7 against 39.1 at thresholds of 0.5, the closest to greedy decoding): fewer false alarms per check account for most of the gain in completion accuracy.
The completion side improves too: with every alarm removed, ECT confirms more steps in time than the variant at every completion threshold from 0.1 to 0.6 (at best 61.3 against 54.6).
blocks.zh:
对于ECT和不配对负数的变体(每组种子为0),我们在QICD测试集的每次检查时都记录了两种概率,并重新播放了正式协议下线;在预注册的解码阈值下,重播匹配两种运行(42.0和31.1)的官方IC-Acc,计及在下一次检查(补充F)时确认的超过日志的几个步骤.
在检查无错误步骤时,7.3%对电磁脉冲产生假警报,18.3%对变体发出假警报,其中26.5%和40.8%的这些步骤被取消。
赋予变体ECT的误差概率,加上其本身的完成概率,其IC-Acc从31.1提高到40.8,接近ECT的42.0(23.1到38.7对39.1的阈值为0.5,最接近贪婪的解码):每检查一次的假警报减少,以计算完成精度的大部分收益.
完成部分也有所改善:随着每个警报器被移除,电算仪在时间上比每个完成阈值0.1到0.6的变体(最佳61.3对54.6)更能证实更多的步骤.

blocks.en:
The negatives trade mistake recall for confirmations: without them mistake F1 on Ego-MC-Bench is higher (0.34) at a completion accuracy 11 points lower, because the model raises alarms in about twice as many steps, at a precision of 0.33 against 0.43 ( Supplement C ), and tripling the clean negatives moves QICD from 40.8 / 0.247 to 52.5 / 0.222.
How many negatives to use is therefore a choice of operating point. Given the same validation cap of 432 raw alarms, the two variants without clean negatives fall 7.1 and 5.9 completion points short of thresholded ECT on QICD ( Supplement D ).
blocks.zh:
负交易错误召回确认:没有错误,Ego-MC-Bench上的F1在完成精度降低11点时会更高(0.34),因为模型在大约两倍于0.43对0.43(补充C)的步数中会发出警报,将清底从40.8/0.247移动到52.5/0.222.
因此,使用多少底片是操作点的选择. 鉴于相同的验证上限为432个原始警报,两个没有干净负数的变体在QICD(补充D)上落下7.1和5.9完成点,低于阈值ECT(补充D).

blocks.en: 7 Limitations and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 限制和结论

blocks.en:
Our study covers cooking, two benchmarks and their official protocol, and Ego-MC-Bench is evaluated by transfer.
A blind learner with more inputs than our definition allows can extend the frontier: one that also sees the durations of the earlier steps of the same recording, which the protocol reveals, brings the QICD margins of greedy ECT to − 0.028 -0.028 – + 0.029 +0.029 , while those on Ego-MC-Bench and the QICD Main set stay positive ( Supplement B ).
ECT improves the timing of what the model says more than the mistakes it catches: its mistake recall stays low (0.18 on Ego-MC-Bench), it separates mistakes from mistake-free completions at a step end less well than fine-tuning without paired negatives ( Supplement E ), and a detection is credited by its time alone. In a manual check of 25 detections, 9 named the annotated mistake, 3 named it in part, and 13 named a different one ( Supplement G ).
blocks.zh:
我们的研究涉及烹饪,两个基准及其官方协议,而Ego-MC-Bench是通过转移来评估的.
盲目的学习者,比我们定义允许的更多投入,可以扩展边框:同样看到同一录制的早期步骤的持续时间,协议揭示了这一点,使得贪婪的QICD边缘ECT达到−0.028 - 0.028 - + 0.029 + 0.029,而Ego-MC-Bench和QICD Main集上的QICD保持正数(补充B).
ECT改进了模型所描述的多于它所发现的错误的时机:它的错误召回仍然很低(在Ego-MC-Bench上是0.18),它把错误和无错误的完成区分在一步端不如没有配对负数的微调好(Supplement E),一个检测被单独计入时间. 在对25个探测器的人工检查中,9个将附加注释的错误命名,3个将其部分命名,13个将另一个命名(补充G.).

blocks.en:
Under their per-step protocol, two benchmarks for proactive guidance currently reward the clock, and the video-blind frontier measures by how much.
ECT moves a 2B model beyond it on both benchmarks without synthetic data or a decision threshold. At equal elapsed time its decisions are set by the video, it ignores the time stamps that a blind model relies on, and its paired negatives work by cutting false alarms at each check. We recommend reporting the margin over the frontier with every result on these benchmarks.
blocks.zh:
根据其按步就班的规程,两项主动指导的基准目前都奖励钟表和视盲前沿措施。
ECT将两个基准上的2B模型移动到它之外,没有合成数据或决定阈值. 在视频设定其决定的同样时间,它忽略了盲人模型所依赖的时间戳,并且通过在每次检查时剪断假警报来对底片进行配对. 我们建议报告边界的差幅,并列出这些基准的每一项结果。

blocks.en: Appendix A Protocol, models and settings
blocks.zh: 附录A 议定书、模式和设置

blocks.en:
We use the official per-step evaluation loop and scorer for both benchmarks. Inference settings and any changes to prompting or answer parsing are described below.
The model is given the ground-truth instruction of the current step; a check is made every 10 frames (5 s at 2 frames per second) on the frames since the annotated start, at most 240 (120 s).
In the protocol described in Sec. 3 , the annotated start anchors the window, but only a model confirmation advances the instruction. If a step is never confirmed, the model keeps being checked on later footage under that instruction and subsequent steps are never reached. In four audited runs on the 36 QICD test recordings, the number of instructions issued equaled the number of confirmations plus one, capped at the number of steps.
At each check the completion question is asked first and, if the answer is negative, the mistake question.
An answer is positive if it contains “yes”; our fine-tuned models answer “YES” or “NO” at the start of the output, so the rule is unambiguous for them.
A mistake-free step contributes an IC hit only if its single prediction is a confirmation within the 15 s tolerance of the annotated step end; any mistake feedback during the step voids the hit. Unreached mistake-free steps remain in the denominator.
The memory prompt is the one-minute feedback memory of Bhattacharyya et al. [11] ; in our runs the memory is cleared at every step.
Of the 40 sessions of Ego-MC-Bench, 39 are released (562 instructions, 397 mistake annotations); the published results use 40.
blocks.zh:
我们使用官方的每步评估循环和计分器来计算这两个基准。 下文介绍推论设置和对提示或回答解析的任何修改。
该模型得到当前步骤的地面真实指示;自附加说明开始以来,每10帧(5秒,每秒2帧)检查一次,最多240帧(120秒)。
在 Sec. 3 中描述的协议中,注释开始锁定窗口,但只有模型确认才能推进指令. 如果一个步骤得不到证实,则该模型继续根据该指示在以后的镜头上检查,其后的步骤也从未达到。 在对36张QICD测试录音进行的四次审计中,发出的指示数等于确认数+1,上限为步骤数。
每次检查时先问完成问题,如果回答是否定的,则问错误问题.
如果答案是肯定的,那么我们的微调模型在产出开始时就回答“YES”或“NO”,所以规则对他们来说是明确的。
无误步骤只有在其单一的预测是在附加说明的步尾的15s耐受度范围内确认的情况下,才会促进IC命中;任何步中的错误反馈都会使命中无效. 未达到的无误步骤仍留在分母中.
记忆提示是Bhattacharyya等人的一分钟反馈记忆. [11];在我们运行中,记忆在每一个步骤都被清除.
在Ego-MC-Bench的40场比赛中,39场发布(562场指令,397场错误说明);公布的结果使用40场.

blocks.en:
The two benchmarks annotate a step with a mistake differently. In QICD Advanced Planning, 236 of the 474 test steps contain a mistake and none of them carries an annotated success: the next step begins after the mistake, in 65 cases with the same instruction. In Ego-MC-Bench, 282 of the 298 steps with a mistake end with a success after the correction, and 16 (3% of all steps) end with the mistake.
Since only a confirmation advances the instruction, a model that withholds confirmation on a failed QICD step stays on it.
Among the recordings that a run leaves before the last step, the step where it stops ends with a mistake in 7 of 14 for zero-shot Qwen3-VL-2B on QICD, 11 of 24 for Qwen3.5-397B and 27 of 36 for Qwen2.5-VL-7B; on Ego-MC-Bench the same models stop at such a step in 0 of 5, 0 of 16 and 1 of 38 recordings, and otherwise at a mistake-free step or after a corrected mistake. The greedy ECT seeds stop early in 0–4 recordings per test set.
Recomputing the IC denominator over the mistake-free steps each run reaches, with the official numerator, zero-shot Qwen3-VL-2B with the memory prompt reaches 385/474 steps on QICD and its IC rises from 10.5 to 13.5; Qwen3.5-397B rises from 18.1 to 28.7 on QICD and from 34.5 to 46.9 on Ego-MC-Bench; no greedy ECT seed changes by more than two points. Zero-shot Qwen2.5-VL-7B reaches only 96/562 steps on Ego-MC-Bench, and its IC on that subset is 58.3 against 8.0 officially. Stalling thus explains part of the official gap of the zero-shot models, and not the low IC of the main zero-shot reference. Each reached-only IC conditions on a model-specific subset; the counts are released with the code.
blocks.zh:
这两个基准用不同的错误来说明一个步骤。 在QICD Advanced Planning中,474个测试步骤中有236个包含一个错误,其中没有任何一个带有附加说明的成功:下一个步骤是在错误发生后开始的,在65个案例中,有相同的指令. 在"Ego-MC-Bench"中,298个步中,有282个步中错误结束,修正后成功,16个步中(占全部步中3%)以错误结束.
由于只有确认才能推进指令,在失败的QICD步骤上拒绝确认的模型仍然留在它上.
在最后一步离开的录音中,停止的台阶在QICD上以14分0射的Qwen3-VL-2B,24分11的Quen3.5-397B和36分27的Qwen2.5-VL-7B上以错误结束;在Ego-MC-Bench上,同一型号在5分0秒,16分0秒,38分1分的录音中以错误结束,否则在无错误的台阶上或经过更正的误差后止步. 贪婪的ECT种子在每套测试的0–4录制中提早停止.
在每次运行的无误步骤上重算IC分母到达,用官方数字,零射的Qwen3-VL-2B,内存提示器在QICD上达到385/474步,其IC从10.5升至13.5;Quen3.5-397B在QICD上从18.1升至28.7,在Ego-MC-Bench上从34.5升至46.9;没有贪心的ECT种子改变2分以上. 0射出的Quen2.5-VL-7B在Ego-MC-Bench上只达到96/562步,其在该子集上的IC是58.3对8.0正式. 因此,Stalling解释了零镜头模型的部分官方空白,而不是主要零镜头参考的低IC. 每个只达到的IC条件在一个模型特定子集上;计数随代码释放.

blocks.en:
Table S1 lists every zero-shot run.
InternVL3.5 [ 52 ] and LLaVA-OneVision [ 35 ] receive 32 frames sampled uniformly from the window, zero-shot and fine-tuned alike.
The Qwen3.5 and Qwen3.8 models are run through a hosted inference service with 16 frames per check (448 pixels wide, with time stamps), the memory prompt, temperature 0 and reasoning disabled.
For these models we append “Start your answer with YES or NO, then give at most one sentence.” to the question and parse only the leading word, because without the suffix some answers contain “yes” mid-sentence.
Requests rejected by the service’s content filter are counted as “NO”; this affects at most 108 checks per model on QICD and none on Ego-MC-Bench.
Two models were accidentally queried twice: the decisions of the two passes agree in 99.9–100% of the checks.
With these settings Qwen3.5-27B reaches 42.0 / 0.068 on Ego-MC-Bench, below the 45.5 / 0.14 published for it with its own settings [ 11 ] ; the paper uses the published value when it discusses published results.
The zero-shot conclusion does not depend on greedy decoding: with sampling, Qwen3-VL-2B reaches 5.5 / 0.099, 3.8 / 0.103 and 2.9 / 0.102 on QICD over three seeds.
blocks.zh:
表S1列出每一次零镜头运行.
InternVL3.5 [52]和LLaVA-One Vision [35]从窗口获得统一取样的32帧,零镜头和微调相同.
Quen3.5和Quen3.8模型通过主机推论服务运行,每检查16帧(宽448像素,带有时间戳),内存提示,温度0和推理功能被禁用.
对于这些模型,我们附加“用是或否开始回答,然后最多给出一句话。” 在问题中只解析一个主词,因为没有后缀,一些答案包含“是”的中句。
被服务内容过滤器拒绝的请求被算作 " NO " ;这影响到每个模型在QICD上最多108次检查,在Ego-MC-Bench上没有。
两次无意中询问了两个型号:两次通行证的决定在99.9-100%的支票中一致。
在这些设置下,Quen3.5-27B在Ego-MC-Bench上达到42.0/0.068,低于为它出版的带有自身设置的45.5/0.14[11];论文在讨论出版结果时使用出版值.
零射结论不依赖于贪婪的解码:通过采样,Qwen3-VL-2B在QICD上通过3个种子达到5.5/0.099,3.8/0.103和2.9/0.102.

blocks.en: Appendix B The video-blind frontier
blocks.zh: 附录B 视盲边界

blocks.en:
The rules use the step start, the elapsed time, the instruction text and statistics of the QICD training split.
(i) Fixed delays: confirm A A seconds into the step; optionally raise one alarm at B B seconds, either in every step or in a fixed fraction of the steps.
(ii) Duration priors: confirm at a multiple of the median training duration of the same instruction (the global median if the instruction is unseen).
(iii) Mistake priors: raise the alarm only for instructions whose mistake rate in the training split exceeds a threshold.
Every rule and every per-step mixture along the hull is scored with the official evaluation code; Tab. S2 gives the vertices.
The main text adds to this hull the learned blind policy on the same inputs described below (“paper’s inputs”); its margins are against that combined frontier. Margins in this supplement are against the rules alone unless stated, and Tab. S4 compares the readings.
If the two delays of the fixed-delay rule are instead chosen on the QICD validation split (alarm at 15 s, confirm at 20 s), the rule reaches a mistake F1 of 0.361 on Ego-MC-Bench.
Above the highest completion accuracy of any blind rule the frontier is zero, so the margin equals the mistake F1 there; the paper marks these cases.
blocks.zh:
规则使用步骤开始,时间过长,教学文本和QICD训练统计分开.
(一)固定延迟:确认A秒进入台阶;可选择在B秒时发出1个警报,要么在每个台阶中发出,要么在固定部分发出。
(二) 持续时间:在同一指令中位数培训时间的倍数上确认(如果该指令不为人所知,则确认全球中位数)。
(三)错误前科:仅针对在训练中误率分裂超过阈值的指令提高警示.
沿船体的每一条规则和每步的混合物都以官方的评价代码评分; Tab. S2给出了顶点.
案文正文将以下同样的投入( " 纸张投入 " )的盲目政策补充到这个整体上;其边缘与这一综合领域相对立。 本副刊中的边距,除非注明,否则只违反规则,Tab. S4比较读数.
如果固定延迟规则的两次延迟被选择在QICD验证拆分上(警报为15s,确认为20s),则规则在Ego-MC-Bench上达到0.361的错误F1.
在任何盲规则的最高完成精确度之上,边框为0,因此比值等于那里的错误F1;纸上标注了这些情况。

blocks.en: Table S2: Vertices of the video-blind frontier used for every margin in the paper (upper convex hull of measured blind policies, tuned on the test set).
blocks.zh: 表S2:用于纸张中每个边距的视盲边框的维度(测量盲度政策的上凸轮体,调用测试集).

blocks.en:
The frontier is a lower bound on what blind policies can do.
As one check, we train a logistic regression on the 52,281 checks of the training split from elapsed time, step index, instruction text and training priors, and threshold its two outputs.
This logistic regression is weaker than the hand-written rules: its best mistake F1 is 0.131 on QICD and 0.175 on Ego-MC-Bench, and its best completion accuracy 38.7 and 46.6; a stronger learner is not, as the next paragraph shows. Table S3 resamples the test videos and recomputes a frontier each time.
This frontier is the hull of 625 single policies (the rules and the learned policy) without the per-step mixtures of the frontier above, so its margins differ slightly from those of the paper (for ECT seed 0, + 0.112 +0.112 against + 0.062 +0.062 ).
blocks.zh:
在盲目政策所能做的方面,前沿是一个较低的界限。
作为一次检查,我们对52 281次从时间、步骤指数、教学文本和培训前科分拆的训练检查进行后勤回归,并限定其两项产出。
这种物流回归比手写规则弱:其最佳错误F1在QICD上为0.131,在Ego-MC-Bench上为0.175,其最佳完成精度38.7和46.6;较强的学习者不是,如下段所示. 表S3重印测试视频,并每次重计算一个边框.
这个边疆是625个单项政策(规则和学到的政策)的船体,没有上面边疆的每步混合物,因此它的边疆与纸张的边疆略微不同(对于ECT种子0,+0.112+0.112对+0.062+0.062).

blocks.en: Table S3: Probability of lying beyond the frontier when the test videos are resampled (2,000 draws; the frontier is recomputed on every draw from 625 blind policies, 49 of them learned), with the 95% interval of the margin. –: not computed.
blocks.zh: 表S3:在测试视频被重印(2,000张图纸;从625个盲点政策中每抽出一次就重新计算出边界,其中49个是学到的)时,在边界之外躺着的可能性,比值为95%。 — — 不计算。

blocks.en:
Gradient-boosted trees predict each step’s duration and mistake probability. They are fit on the QICD training and validation splits, which the official loader combines, without test recordings. A policy confirms at a multiple of the predicted duration plus an offset and raises one alarm at another such time if the predicted mistake probability exceeds a threshold, giving 18,900 policies.
With the inputs of the paper’s definition (instruction text, step index, elapsed time and training priors), and more so when it also sees the position in the plan and the observed durations of the earlier steps of the recording, which the protocol reveals, this learner extends the frontier: tuned on the test set like the rules, its best mistake F1 rises from 0.317 to 0.353 and 0.361 on QICD and from 0.219 to 0.232 and 0.258 on the Main set.
Every policy on the new hull was re-scored with the official evaluation code, and the hand-written rules, re-implemented in the same scorer, reproduce the hull of the single rules on all three test sets to within 0.001 in F1.
The extension persists when policies are selected by their scores on one half of the test recordings and evaluated on the other. The candidate alarm thresholds are quantiles of predictions on the full test set, computed without its labels. Table S4 gives the margins of ECT under all three readings.
On QICD Advanced Planning, the margins of ECT with greedy decoding shrink from + 0.062 +0.062 – + 0.107 +0.107 to + 0.012 +0.012 – + 0.061 +0.061 with the paper’s inputs (the frontier of the main text) and to − 0.028 -0.028 – + 0.029 +0.029 with all inputs. Held out, a seed is beyond in 87–97% of the 500 splits with the paper’s inputs (99–100% on Ego-MC-Bench) and in 70–96% with all inputs, and the mean margin of every seed stays positive.
The thresholded variant remains beyond under every reading ( + 0.032 +0.032 or more when tuned on the test set).
On the Main set the pattern is reversed: greedy decoding remains beyond ( + 0.025 +0.025 – + 0.125 +0.125 with all inputs, held out with probability 0.97–1.00), while the margins of the thresholded variant, which were + 0.022 +0.022 – + 0.050 +0.050 , fall to about zero with all inputs.
On Ego-MC-Bench the margins of greedy decoding hardly change ( + 0.162 +0.162 – + 0.278 +0.278 ); one thresholded seed falls just inside the frontier ( − 0.026 -0.026 with all inputs).
Of the 104 results with a margin in our tables (including the published results on the Main set), none of the 40 inside the frontier of the paper moves out of it; of the 64 beyond it, 58 stay beyond with the paper’s inputs and 50 with all inputs.
With all inputs, Qwen3.5-397B-A17B on Ego-MC-Bench moves inside ( + 0.021 +0.021 to − 0.084 -0.084 ), Qwen3.8-Max stays just beyond ( + 0.126 +0.126 to + 0.014 +0.014 ), and on the Main set LiveMamba stays just beyond ( + 0.056 +0.056 to + 0.014 +0.014 ) and the challenge winner well beyond ( + 0.250 +0.250 ).
Every ECT seed is beyond the hand-written frontier on both benchmarks. Against the all-input learned frontier, each test set has at least one ECT decoding that remains beyond the frontier, but neither decoding does so on all three test sets. The QICD margins are small.
blocks.zh:
渐变的树会预测每一步的时间和误差概率。 它们适合QICD的培训和验证拆分,正式加载机结合使用,没有测试录音. 一项政策在预计时间的倍数加上抵消后,在预计误差概率超过阈值时在另一时点发出警报,给予18 900项政策。
随着文件定义的投入(指示文本、步骤索引、经过时间和培训前科),更何况,当它也看到计划中的位置和记录早期步骤的观察时间(协议揭示了这一点)时,这个学习者扩展了前沿:按照规则一样的试验集,其最佳错误F1从QICD上的0.317升至0.353和0.361,从主集的0.219升至0.232和0.258。
新船体上的每一条政策都以官方的评价代码重新打分,手写规则在同一计分器中重新执行,将所有三套测试的单套规则的船体复制到F1的0.001范围内.
如果政策根据测试录音的一半的分数加以选择并按另一部分加以评价,则延长期将持续。 候选的警报阈值是完全测试组的预测量的四分数,没有标注。 表S4列出了所有三种读数下的电磁学差值。
在QICD高级计划上,带有贪婪解码的ECT的边缘从+0.062+0.062 – + 0.107+ 0.107 → + 0.012+ 0.012 – + 0.061+ 0.061 与纸张的输入(正文的前沿)缩水到− 0.028- 0.028 – + 0.029+ 0.029 与所有输入. 即便如此,在报纸投入的500分中,有87-97分(Ego-MC-Bench为99-100分)的种子被淘汰,70-96分(所有投入)的种子被淘汰,每个种子的平均值都保持正值。
阈值变体在每次读数(在测试集上调值时,+ 0.032+ 0.032或以上)下仍为超值.
在主设定上,模式被逆转:贪婪的解码仍然超出(+0.025+0.025 – + 0.125+0.125)所有输入,以概率 0.97–1.00保持,而阈值变体的边距为+0.022+0.022 – + 0.050+0.050,则随着所有输入下降到大约零.
在Ego-MC-Bench上,贪婪的解码边缘几乎没有变化(+0.162+0.162–+0.278+0.278);一个阈值种子掉落到边界之内(-0.026-0026)。

The main paper takes the published per-step scores from Tables 2 and 3 of arXiv:2606.09547v2 [ 11 ] .
In v3, the same-backbone Qwen3-VL-2B (Ego-CoMist+) changes from 30.4 / 0.16 to 30.4 / 0.20 (IC-Acc / mistake F1), and the highest-F1 baseline, Qwen3.5-2B (Ego-CoMist+), changes from 37.1 / 0.20 to 33.0 / 0.27.
Comparing the 18 reported v3 scores with our frontiers, at least two lie above the rule frontier and none lies above the frontier of the main text, even when the learner uses only the paper’s inputs. The published models were not rerun on our test recordings.

blocks.en:
Over individual checks, raw elapsed time barely predicts the answer: its area under the ROC curve (AUROC) for the completion and the mistake question is 0.525 and 0.521 on the QICD test set, 0.558 and 0.500 on the validation split, and 0.342 and 0.432 on Ego-MC-Bench, where a longer elapsed time makes a positive answer less likely.
Elapsed time relative to the median training duration of the same instruction separates the completion answers better: AUROC 0.61 on the QICD test set and 0.69 on the validation split, with durations from the 209 training videos only (almost no Ego-MC-Bench instruction occurs in training).
The checks of the protocol thus carry a timing signal that a fine-tuned model can learn without the video. A negative drawn at the same elapsed time as its positive removes raw elapsed time from the pair, but only part of this signal, because the two checks usually belong to different instructions; Appendix E measures what remains.
Beyond this signal, the blind rules score through the sequential protocol.
The tolerance windows around annotated events cover 20.6% of the stream time on the QICD test set and 28.9% on Ego-MC-Bench.
In QICD, 91% of the mistake feedback of the test set (89% of the validation split) is annotated at the end of the step; in Ego-MC-Bench, 4%.
On Ego-MC-Bench, 27 of the 264 mistake-free steps (10%), 25 of them the last step of a session, carry only the instruction in the annotation, so their annotated end coincides with their start and any confirmation within 15 s of the step start is credited; the zero-shot model is credited for 12 of them and ECT for 10–12.
Priors from the training split matter where recipes repeat: adding them to elapsed time raises the best blind F1 on QICD from 0.024 to 0.129 at IC-Acc ≥ 40 \geq 40 and from 0.097 to 0.239 at IC-Acc ≥ 30 \geq 30 , and on Ego-MC-Bench from 0.107 to 0.130 at IC-Acc ≥ 40 \geq 40 .
blocks.zh:
在个别检查中,原始时间几乎无法预测答案:在ROC曲线(AUROC)下完成的面积,错误问题在QICD测试机组上为0.525和0.521,在验证机组上为0.558和0.500,在Ego-MC-Bench上为0.342和0.432,由于时间较长,答案不太可能是肯定的。
相对于同一指令的中位培训时间而言,耗时时间将完成回答区分得更好:在QICD测试集上为AUROC 0.61,在验证分时为0.69,时间长度仅来自209培训视频(培训中几乎没有Ego-MC-Bench教学)。
因此,对协议的检查带有一个计时信号,一个微调的模型可以在没有视频的情况下学习. 在正时段抽取的负数会从对数中去除原始的过去时间,但只有这个信号的一部分,因为这两个检查通常属于不同的指示; 附录E衡量剩下的是什么.
在此信号之外,盲规则通过顺序协议得分.
附加说明的事件周围的耐受性窗口覆盖了QICD测试集的20.6%的溪流时间和Ego-MC-Bench的28.9%.
在QICD中,91%的测试集错误反馈(89%的验证拆分)在步骤结尾处附加注释;在Ego-MC-Bench中,4%.
在Ego-MC-Bench上,264个无错步中27个(10%),其中25个是会话的最后一步,只携带注释中的指示,所以他们的注解结尾与他们的开始吻合,任何在步骤开始的15秒之内的确认都贷记;其中12个为零镜头模型,ECT为10–12.
以往训练中出现食谱重复的分裂事项:将QICD上最好的失明F1从0.024提高到0.129,在IC-Acc 40\geq 40上从0.097提高到0.239,在EC-Acc 30\geq 30上从0.107提高到0.130,在EC-Acc 40\geq 40上从0.107提高到0.130。

blocks.en:
For GuideMe [ 39 ] we re-read the 13 speaking-time results of its main table; we run no model on it.
We use the public test annotations (473 videos, 9,479 response points) and the official scoring script, and no video.
The sampling of silent points is not part of the released code and is reconstructed from the description in the paper; the reconstruction gives a silent share of 43.74%, against the 43.6 reported for a system that never speaks.
The blind rules respond as a function of the time since the previous response, optionally with response-rate priors; since the training annotations are not public, the priors are cross-fitted on the test videos in five folds. Table S5 compares each published result with the blind policy at the same false-alarm rate.
Margins within about one point should be read as “on the frontier”.
The scores of the benchmark’s language-model judge are not reproduced.
A policy that never speaks obtains a score of 43.7, which matches or exceeds 11 of the 13 results.

Table S8 collects the remaining single-seed runs.
The amount of clean negatives moves the operating point: fewer give a lower completion accuracy and a higher mistake F1, more the reverse.
The decomposition of Tab. S19 shows how: from 0.75 times to three times the clean negatives, the share of mistake-free steps voided by a false alarm falls from 22.3% to 9.2%, and the accuracy on mistake pairs rises from 0.732 to 0.770 (0.745–0.769 for the four seeds of ECT; Tab. S16 ).
The amount of training data does not act monotonically: with 48 videos ECT is beyond the frontier on both benchmarks, and with 102 videos it is inside on QICD ( Δ = − 0.025 \Delta=-0.025 ) and beyond on Ego-MC-Bench; with one seed each we draw no conclusion about data efficiency.
Two variants were evaluated on the test sets and not adopted: adding cross-recording pairs to the loss, and an auxiliary loss that aligns situations with feedback texts.
Both lie beyond the frontier; we did not adopt them because they add machinery without a consistent gain (the first has a significantly lower mistake F1 on Ego-MC-Bench).

On Ego-MC-Bench, the number of mistake-free steps confirmed more than 15 s before their end is 37–42 for the four seeds of ECT and 55 for “+ notdone”, against 62 for “+ clean” and 82 without paired negatives; on QICD the counts are 35–41 and 49, against 50 and 65 (75 with re-balanced sampling); the ablated variants have one seed each in these counts. Table S9 focuses on the longest third of the mistake-free steps, where early confirmations are most likely, with two seeds of each ablated variant.
On the 84 long steps of Ego-MC-Bench, ECT confirms on time 14.3 points more often than “+ clean” (95% interval [ + 5.8 , + 24.4 ] [+5.8,+24.4] ), mostly because it confirms early less often ( − 9.5 -9.5 points) and partly because it raises fewer alarms ( − 6.0 -6.0 , not significant); every seed of ECT (33–54%) is above both seeds of “+ clean” (25 and 31%).
The on-time gain persists on long steps whose instructions state no duration: + 12.5 +12.5 points [ + 3.8 , + 21.6 ] [+3.8,+21.6] . Among steps whose instructions state a duration, early confirmation falls by 21.6 points [ − 37.5 , − 6.7 ] [-37.5,-6.7] .
Steps of at least 20 s confirmed at the very first check, 5 s after their start, are 4.3–7.2% for ECT against 9.4 and 12.2% for “+ clean” ( − 4.9 -4.9 points [ − 7.1 , − 2.8 ] [-7.1,-2.8] ).
With notdone negatives alone, 27.4% of long steps are confirmed on time.
On QICD, whose test recipes all occur in training so that duration priors are informative, no such difference appears ( − 1.9 -1.9 points [ − 9.5 , + 4.5 ] [-9.5,+4.5] on time). Figure S1 illustrates the pattern with one step chosen by a fixed rule.
