blocks.en:
Without paired negatives the mistake F1 on Ego-MC-Bench is higher than that of ECT. Table S10 asks where an F1 comes from, with two nulls that keep the alarms of a run.
Permuting the alarms across steps lowers the F1 of every fine-tuned model by a third or more, so these models pick steps that contain a mistake; the zero-shot 2B model does no better than its permuted alarms.
Moving the alarms to random checks inside their steps changes the F1 by at most 0.03: with a tolerance of ± \pm 15 s and free repeats inside the window, the metric hardly scores when in a step an alarm is raised.
The variant without negatives reaches its higher F1 by raising more than twice as many alarms as ECT on average, in about twice as many steps and at lower precision (0.33 versus 0.43); the price is the completion accuracy, since every alarm in a mistake-free step voids it.
blocks.zh:
不配对负数 Ego-MC-Bench上的错误F1比ECT要高. 表S10询问一个F1从何而来,有两个空位保留运行的提醒.
夹击跨步的警报将每个微调模型的F1降低三分之一或更多,因此这些模型选择了包含错误的步骤;零射2B模型并不比它的穿透式警报更好.
将提醒移动到其步骤内部的随机检查最多会使F1改变0.03:在 ±\pm 15 s 的容限下,并在窗口内自由重复,当一个步骤中提醒时,度量值几乎没有得分.
无负数的变体达到其较高的F1,平均提出比ECT多一倍以上的警报,在大约两倍的步数和较低的精度(0.33对0.43);价格是完成精度,因为每一次无错误的步数中的警报都会使其失效.

blocks.en: Table S10: What the mistake F1 on Ego-MC-Bench rewards. “On mistake steps”: share of the alarms raised in steps that contain a mistake (53% of the steps do). “Times shuffled”: the alarms stay in their steps and are moved to random checks of the step. “Steps shuffled”: the alarm patterns are permuted across the steps of the same video. Means and 95% ranges over 500 draws; our re-implementation of the official matching reproduces the counts of the official evaluation for every run.
blocks.zh: 表S10: 国家 Ego-MC-Bench上的错误F1有什么奖励. “错误步骤”:在包含错误的步骤(53%的步骤)中发出的警报份额。 “时间被洗涤”:警报会停留在台阶上,然后转到对台阶进行随机检查。 “Steps shuffled”:警报模式贯穿同一视频的台阶。 手段和95%在500平方英尺之间;我们重新实施正式匹配,复制了每次运行的官方评价的计数。

blocks.en: Table S11 gives the streaming results that the paper summarizes.
blocks.zh: 表S11列出了文件总结的流出结果。

blocks.en: Table S11: Streaming protocol (no restart at ground-truth step starts): IC-Acc / mistake F1. The streaming blind frontier is low, because the errors of a blind rule accumulate across steps; the zero-shot model on Ego-MC-Bench and LiveMamba on QICD also lie beyond it, so we do not use it as evidence in the paper.
blocks.zh: 表S11: 国家 流线协议(在地面真实步骤开始时没有重启): IC-Acc / mistake F1. 流畅的盲目边疆是很低的,因为盲目规则的错误会累积跨步骤;在Ego-MC-Bench和QICD上的LiveMamba上的零射线模型也存在于它之外,所以我们不把它作为论文中的证据.

blocks.en:
The paper uses the Advanced Planning set of QICD. Table S12 repeats the evaluation on its Main set (109 test videos, none of them in our training or validation data; 36 of them are the recordings of the Advanced Planning test set, here with the plans of the Main set), under the per-step protocol with the official prompts and evaluation and both decodings, and compares with the results published on this set: those of the benchmark paper [ 10 ] and those reported for the benchmark’s 2026 challenge [ 50 ] .
The video-blind frontier of this set is built as in Appendix B ; its vertices are (16.5, 0.219), (18.7, 0.219), (27.4, 0.217), (32.9, 0.214), (37.6, 0.198), (47.3, 0.153), (51.0, 0.134), (54.1, 0.078), (56.3, 0.000).
The general-purpose models and the second challenge entry lie inside it. Two published systems lie beyond it: LiveMamba ( + 0.056 +0.056 ) and the challenge winner, a training-free pipeline of two proprietary models ( + 0.306 +0.306 ).
ECT lies beyond it with nothing trained or tuned on the Main set: all four seeds with greedy decoding ( + 0.072 +0.072 to + 0.181 +0.181 ), all four with the thresholds frozen on the Advanced Planning validation split ( + 0.022 +0.022 to + 0.050 +0.050 ), and the recipe on Qwen3-VL-4B ( + 0.151 +0.151 ), InternVL3.5-2B ( + 0.103 +0.103 ) and LLaVA-OneVision-7B ( + 0.017 +0.017 ).
The same fine-tuning without paired negatives (two seeds, − 0.032 -0.032 and − 0.046 -0.046 ) and all zero-shot models lie inside (from − 0.058 -0.058 for Qwen3.5-397B-A17B to − 0.217 -0.217 for InternVL3.5-2B).
With greedy decoding, the mistake F1 of ECT (0.192–0.224) is close to that of LiveMamba (0.19) and the second challenge entry (0.20) and below that of the winner (0.31), at a completion accuracy of 47.4–56.0 against 51.0, 31.4 and 56.2.
These runs were made after the challenge had closed and are not challenge entries.
blocks.zh:
论文采用了QICD的高级规划集. 表S12重复了其主集的评价(109个测试视频,我们的培训或验证数据中都没有这些视频;其中36个是高级规划测试集的录音,这里有主集的计划),按照与官方提示和评价的按步协议进行,同时进行解码,并与本集公布的结果进行比较:基准文件[10]和基准2026挑战报告的结果[50].
本集的视盲边框如附录B所建;其顶点为(16.5,0.219),(18.7,0.219),(27.4,0.217),(32.9,0.214),(37.6,0.198),(47.3,0.153),(51.0,0.134),(54.1,0.078),(56.3,0.000).
通用模型和第二个挑战条目就在其中。 两个已公布的系统位于它之外:LiveMamba(+0.056+0.056)和挑战胜者,两个专有型号的无培训管道(+0.306+0.306).
ECT位于它之外,没有经过任何训练或调试的主机:所有4个种子都有贪婪的解码(+0.072+0.072+++0.81+0.181),所有4个种子都有在高级规划验证分解(+0.022+0.022++0.050)上冻结的阈值,以及Qune3-VL-4B(+0.151+0.151),InternVL3.5-2B(+0.103+0.103)和LlaVA-Onevision-7B(+0.017+0.017)上的配方.
同样的不配对负数的微调(两个种子,− 0.032-0.032和− 0.046-0.046)和所有的零射线模型都位于内部(从− 0.058-0.058,Quen3.5-397B-A17B到−0.217-0.217,INNVL3.5-2B).
凭借着贪婪的解码,ECT(0.192–0.224)的错误F1接近LiveMamba(0.19)和第二次挑战条目(0.20),低于胜者(0.31),完成精度为47.4–56.0对51.0,31.4和56.2.
这些运行是在挑战结束后进行的,不是质疑条目。

blocks.en: Table S12: The Main set of QICD under the per-step protocol (IC-Acc / mistake F1 and margin over the video-blind frontier of this set). Published values are as reported, with two decimals. Our models are those of the paper, trained on the Advanced Planning set, with nothing tuned on the Main set; the thresholded rows use the thresholds frozen on the Advanced Planning validation split.
blocks.zh: 表S12: 国家 每步协议下的QICD主集(IC-Acc / mistake F1和本集视频盲边框的比值). 公布的数值为报告值,小数点为两个。 我们的模型是那些在高级规划集上训练的论文,没有在主集上调音;阈值行使用在高级规划验证拆分上冻结的阈值.

blocks.en: Table S13: Two controls with the recipe of ECT and the same seeds: negatives drawn at random moments of the same steps instead of the matched elapsed time, and training and testing on black frames (a learned video-blind model).
blocks.zh: 表S13: 国家 带有ECT和相同种子的配方的两种控制:在相同步骤的随机瞬间抽取底片而不是对应的经过时间,以及在黑框上进行训练和测试(一种学习到的视盲模型).

blocks.en: Table S13 compares matched negatives with an equal number drawn at random moments within the same steps. On QICD, relative to ECT with the same seed, IC changes by + 0.0 +0.0 [ − 5.3 , + 4.9 ] [-5.3,+4.9] and − 3.8 -3.8 [ − 10.1 , + 2.7 ] [-10.1,+2.7] points, and mistake F1 by + 0.075 +0.075 [ + 0.021 , + 0.128 ] [+0.021,+0.128] and − 0.013 -0.013 [ − 0.071 , + 0.035 ] [-0.071,+0.035] (paired 95% video-bootstrap intervals, seeds 0 and 1). Accuracy on mistake pairs is 0.780 and 0.700, versus 0.766 and 0.745 for matched ECT. Elapsed time alone gives AUROC 0.555–0.561 for completion and 0.607–0.620 for mistakes on the random-moment examples, versus 0.541 and 0.606 with matching: within a recording, random moments leave elapsed time almost as uninformative as matched ones.

Transfer to Ego-MC-Bench. We evaluated the same two existing random-moment adapters on the 39 released videos, without training or tuning for this test. Their official IC/F1 is 59.5/0.272 and 57.6/0.261. Both IC values exceed the maximum IC of the canonical blind family, so the corresponding margins are + 0.272 +0.272 and + 0.261 +0.261 . We specified the same-seed comparisons before these runs and resampled the same 39 videos for each pair (2,000 draws, bootstrap seed 0). In seed 0, random rather than matched moments reduce IC by 7.6 7.6 points (signed difference [ − 12.2 , − 3.2 ] [-12.2,-3.2] ) but raise F1 by 0.063 0.063 [ + 0.013 , + 0.109 ] [+0.013,+0.109] . In seed 1, the differences are + 3.4 +3.4 points [ − 2.2 , + 8.4 ] [-2.2,+8.4] and + 0.033 +0.033 [ − 0.003 , + 0.074 ] [-0.003,+0.074] . For on-time confirmation on the 282 mistake-then-success steps, the corresponding differences are − 2.5 -2.5 points [ − 7.1 , + 1.5 ] [-7.1,+1.5] and + 1.8 +1.8 [ − 3.0 , + 6.9 ] [-3.0,+6.9] (all 282 reached in all four runs; not official IC).
blocks.zh: 转会到Ego-MC-Bench. 我们评价了39个发布视频上相同的两个现有的随机动态适配器,没有为此测试进行培训或调试. 他们的官方IC/F1是59.5/0.272和57.6/0.261. 两个IC值都超过了犬目盲族的最大IC,因此相应的边值为+0.272+0.272和+0.261+0.261. 我们在运行前指定了相同的种子比较,并对每对相同的39个视频(2 000张图纸、靴子种子0)重新进行了复制。 在0号种子中,随机而非匹配瞬间将IC减少7.6分(签名差[−12.2,−3.2] [12.2-3.2]),但将F1提高0.063 0.063 [+0.013,+0.109] [+0.013,+0.109]. 在种子1中,差别是+3.4+3.4分[−2.2,+8.4][−2.2,+8.4]和+0.033+0.033[−0.003,+0.074][−0.003,+0.074][0.003,+0.074]. 对于282个误差-当时成功步骤的实时确认,相应的差异为−2.5-2.5分[−7.1,+1.5] [7.1,+1.5]和+1.8+1.8 [−3.0,+6.9] [3.0,+6.9] (所有4个运行中达到全部282分;不是官方IC).

blocks.en: Both kinds of same-recording negatives put the model beyond the frontier; the choice moves the IC/F1 trade-off on Ego-MC-Bench in seed 0, in a direction that seed 1 does not repeat. The variant in Tab. S8 adds cross-recording pairs to the loss.
blocks.zh: 两种相同的记录底片都使得模型超越了边界;选择将IC/F1在Ego-MC-Bench上的比对在0种子中,移动到1种子不重复的方向. Tab. S8中的变体在损失中增加了交叉记录对.

blocks.en: Official IC excludes steps containing mistakes. To check whether the timing behavior also appears on such steps, we re-read frozen predictions on the 282 Ego-MC-Bench steps with an annotated success after the last annotated mistake. The first confirmation is on time if it falls strictly within 15 s of the last success; for the fine-tuned runs below all 282 steps were reached. Averaged over seeds, the rates are 56.4% for ECT (four seeds), 53.7% for “+ clean”, 54.1% for “+ notdone”, and 42.0% with no paired negatives (two seeds each). Relative to “+ clean”, ECT has fewer early confirmations ( − 5.1 -5.1 points [ − 7.7 , − 2.6 ] [-7.7,-2.6] ) but more late or absent confirmations ( + 2.5 +2.5 [ + 1.1 , + 3.9 ] [+1.1,+3.9] ); the net on-time gain is + 2.7 +2.7 [ + 0.4 , + 5.0 ] [+0.4,+5.0] (paired 95% video-bootstrap intervals). The planned short-step check did not pass: late or absent confirmations also increased for short steps. This retrospective endpoint does not explain the difference between the two benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 官方IC排除包含错误的步骤. 为了检查计时行为是否也出现在这些步骤上,我们重读了282 Ego-MC-Bench步骤上的冷冻预测,并在上次附加注释的错误后获得了附加注释的成功. 如果严格在最后成功15秒以内,第一个确认是及时的;因为微调后的运行低于全部282步。 平均比种子高56.4%的ECT(4个种子),53.7%的“+清洁”,54.1%的“+无线”,42.0%的无对负数(各2个种子)。 相对于“+清洁”,ECT的早期确认较少(− 5.1-5.1分[− 7.7,− 2.6] [7.7, 2.6]),但更晚或没有确认(+ 2.5 +2.5 [+ 1.1,+ 3.9] [+1.1,+3.9]);实时净收益为+ 2.7 +2.7 [+ 0.4,+5.0] [+0.4,+5.0] (允许95%的视频-波茨图间隔). 计划的短步检查没有通过:短步检查的迟到或缺席确认也有所增加。 这一追溯性终点并不能解释这两个基准之间的差别。

blocks.en: The text-duration heuristic reaches 39.4%, with its delays chosen on this same cohort; only 14 instructions explicitly state a time. On InternVL3.5-2B (one seed), ECT and no paired negatives reach 49.3% and 35.8%, respectively, on the same 282 steps.
blocks.zh: 文本长度弹性达到39.4%,在同一组中选择了延迟;只有14个指令明确说明了每次时间。 在InternVL3.5-2B(一个种子)上,ECT和无对负数分别达到49.3%和35.8%在同一282步上.

blocks.en:
The last two rows of Tab. S13 train and test the recipe of ECT on black frames, so that the model has only the instruction, the length of the window and what it learned in training.
Both seeds stay inside the frontier: they never raise an alarm and reach a completion accuracy of 10.1 and 18.1 (mean 14.1, as reported in the main text), where the hand-written rules reach a mistake F1 of 0.316 and 0.307.
On the time-matched pairs they score 0.62–0.64 and 0.54–0.56, the part above 0.50 coming from the instruction text, against 0.90 and 0.75–0.77 for ECT with the same seeds.
Under the same training recipe, the black-frame models do not reproduce the performance of ECT with real video.
blocks.zh:
Tab. S13的最后两列列车在黑框上测试了ECT的配方,这样模型就只有指令,窗口长度和在训练中学到的.
两种种子都停留在边界内:它们从不发出警报,达到10.1和18.1的完成精度(正文中报告的平均值为14.1),其中手写规则误差为F10.316和0.307.
在时间匹配的对子上,它们得分为0.62–0.64和0.54–0.56,高于0.50的部分来自指令文本,而使用相同种子的ECT则得分为0.90和0.75–0.77。
在同一训练食谱下,黑框模型不会用真实的视频复制ECT的性能.

blocks.en: Appendix D Decoding, thresholds and operating points
blocks.zh: 附录D 解码、阈值和操作点

blocks.en:
Before any test run of ECT we pre-registered a variant that reads the probability of “yes” at the first answer token and compares it with two thresholds chosen on the validation split by a fixed rule (0.2 for completion, 0.35 for mistakes), and froze it.
Greedy decoding is the main setting because it is deterministic and needs no validation data; it became the main setting after both decodings, run in the same frozen batch, had been evaluated on the test sets, and both are reported for every seed. Table S6 reports both for every seed: thresholds help every seed on QICD and lower completion accuracy on Ego-MC-Bench.
blocks.zh:
在对ECT进行测试之前,我们预先登记了一个变体,该变体在第一个回答符号上读到“是”的概率,并将其与用固定规则(完成0.2,错误0.35)分割验证时选定的两个阈值相比较,并将其冻结。
贪婪的解码是主要设置,因为它是决定性的,不需要验证数据;它成为两个解码器之后的主要设置,运行在同一批冷冻的批次中,在测试集上进行了评价,每个种子都报告两者. 表S6对每个种子都作了报告:阈值有助于每个种子在QICD上得到帮助,在Ego-MC-Bench上的完成精度较低。

blocks.en:
We select each variant’s threshold on the validation split under the same cap as thresholded ECT: 432 raw alarms. Using scored alarms for both ECT and the variants (a cap of 387) selects the same thresholds. Table S14 replays the test runs from their logged probabilities at these thresholds, without matching test-set alarm counts.
At this cap, the two variants without clean negatives have the largest QICD IC shortfalls relative to thresholded ECT seed 0 ( − 7.1 -7.1 and − 5.9 -5.9 points; both 95% intervals just exclude zero). Their intervals for QICD F1 and for both Ego-MC-Bench metrics span zero.
With clean negatives alone (“+ clean”), IC is 2.9 points lower on QICD and 3.0 points lower on Ego-MC-Bench; both intervals span zero. On Ego-MC-Bench its mistake F1 is higher by + 0.058 +0.058 [ + 0.012 , + 0.104 ] [+0.012,+0.104] .
These are single-seed comparisons with unadjusted video-bootstrap intervals; Tab. S14 reports equivalence tests separately. The long-step analysis in Appendix C asks how adding notdone negatives to a recipe with clean negatives changes early confirmations on Ego-MC-Bench.
blocks.zh:
我们选择每个变体的阈值在与阈值ECT相同的阈值下分割:432个原始警报。 对ECT和变体(上限为387)都使用得分的提醒来选择相同的阈值. 表S14重播测试从这些阈值上记录的概率,而不匹配测试集的提醒计数.
在这个封顶上,两个没有清洁底片的变种相对于阈值ECT种子0(−7.1-7.1和−5.9-5.9分)的QICDIC缺量最大;两者的95%的间隔只是排除0. 它们为QICD F1和Ego-MC-Bench两个度量衡的间隔跨度为零.
光是干净的负数(“+干净”),在QICD上IC就低2.9分,在Ego-MC-Bench上则低3.0分;两个间隔跨度均为零. 在Ego-MC-Bench上,它的错误F1比0.058+0.058[+0.012,+0.104][+0.012,+0.104]更高.
这些是单种种子与未经调整的视频波纹间隔的比较; Tab. S14分别报告等效测试. 附录C中的长步分析询问,如何在食谱中添加带有干净的负片的无色底片,从而改变Ego-MC-Bench上的早期确认.

blocks.zh: 共享验证上限是二级操作点比较,与官方主表分数分离.

Table S15 and Fig. S2 sweep the alarm threshold of each thresholded model on the test set.
On QICD, a thresholded model without paired negatives reaches similar IC but lower F1 than thresholded ECT seed 0: 41.2 / 0.262 at a threshold of 0.75, versus 42.0 / 0.306 for ECT.

表S15和图。 S2在测试集上扫清每个阈值模型的警报阈值.

The QICD logs of the 2B ECT runs cannot be replayed exactly from these logs, so those cells are empty ( Appendix F replays seed 0 on QICD from per-check logs recorded later).

The sweeps of ECT itself can be replayed on Ego-MC-Bench only. On QICD the ablated variants pass close to ECT’s operating point and separate at high completion accuracy; on Ego-MC-Bench the curves of ECT lie to the right of the others.

blocks.en:
We ran each configuration once per test set, except for the duplicate zero-shot queries noted in Appendix A .
Before the configuration of ECT was frozen, the zero-shot models and the plain fine-tuning recipe of the ablation had already been evaluated on both test sets.
ECT was then selected and frozen on the validation split alone; its test runs, the three further seeds, the ablations, the other backbones and sizes, and the variants of Tab. S8 were registered before they were run. Greedy decoding was chosen as the main setting after both decodings had been run on the test sets.
The runs added later were registered in the same way before they were run: the two further seeds of “+ notdone”, the random-moment negatives, the models trained on black frames, the step-aligned swap and the evaluation on the Main set (both decodings), on which nothing was tuned.
The Ego-MC-Bench evaluation of the existing random-moment adapters used a separately specified comparison with same-seed ECT ( Appendix C ). The reach and mistake-then-success diagnostics, stronger learned blind policy, shared alarm-cap comparison, long-step timing analysis and case review were designed or revised after the original test results were available, and so were the clock analyses of Appendices B , F and H (relative-duration AUROC, protocol replay, zero-shot alarms, time-stamp probe) and the use of the learned blind policy in the frontier of the main text. For the replay we logged the probabilities of both questions at every check of the QICD test set for two frozen models (ECT seed 0 and the variant without paired negatives); these runs replay or perturb frozen models. They do not select new model parameters or change the primary endpoint.
Both pre-registered decodings were run in the same frozen batch and are reported for every seed.

blocks.en:
A completion pair is a check at which a step has ended and a check of another step of the same recording at the same elapsed time that still has at least 20 s to run; a mistake pair is a check at an annotated mistake and a check of a mistake-free step of the same recording at the same elapsed time with at least 15 s to run.
The QICD test videos give 417 completion pairs and 514 mistake pairs; in three pairs the two windows differ in length by more than one frame because the video ends. Table S16 gives all models and Fig. S3 the summary.
The two checks of a pair share the elapsed time and the window length but usually not the instruction (they share it in 35 of the completion and 56 of the mistake pairs). A blind policy that ranks them by elapsed time over the median training duration of their instruction scores 0.651 on completion pairs and 0.539 on mistake pairs, and the recipe of ECT trained on black frames 0.62–0.64 and 0.54–0.56 ( Appendix C ); ECT scores 0.90–0.92 and 0.75–0.77.
Differences between groups of models, with 95% intervals from a paired bootstrap over videos:
ECT against the three models without paired negatives (two seeds and the re-balanced variant), + 0.020 +0.020 [ − 0.002 , + 0.046 ] [-0.002,+0.046] on completion pairs and + 0.104 +0.104 [ + 0.044 , + 0.156 ] [+0.044,+0.156] on mistake pairs;
“+ clean” and “+ notdone” against the same three models on mistake pairs, + 0.088 +0.088 [ + 0.027 , + 0.146 ] [+0.027,+0.146] and + 0.061 +0.061 [ + 0.024 , + 0.099 ] [+0.024,+0.099] (two seeds each);
ECT against “+ clean” on completion pairs, + 0.022 +0.022 [ + 0.004 , + 0.040 ] [+0.004,+0.040] .
On the side of the pair without evidence, ECT gives “yes” a probability above 0.5 in 6–9% of the completion pairs and 4–8% of the mistake pairs, against 20–22% and 23–32% for the three models without them.
In QICD most mistake feedback is annotated at the end of the step, so a mistake pair usually also differs in how close the step is to its end: for 490 of the 505 distinct positives fewer than 15 s of the step remain, while the negative side has at least 15 s to run by construction.
As a control we compare, on the fixed validation situations of Tab. S24 , the probability of “yes” to the mistake question at annotated mistakes with that at the completion of mistake-free steps, within 10 s bins of elapsed time, so that both sides lie at a step end.
The AUROC is 0.57–0.64 for ECT (seeds 0–2), 0.65 for “+ clean”, 0.73 for “+ notdone” and 0.74 without paired negatives (ECT minus the last, 95% interval [ − 0.18 , − 0.09 ] [-0.18,-0.09] ).
Together with Tab. S24 , this suggests that ECT’s gain on mistake pairs reflects fewer alarms while steps are still running, rather than better discrimination at the step end.
The price is visible in the “both right” column: ECT ranks mistake pairs better but answers “yes” less often on the side with the mistake, which is the low mistake recall discussed in the paper.

Tables S19 and S20 give the decomposition behind the corresponding figure of the paper for more models.
On QICD, up to 4.6% of the mistake-free steps fall in a category that the figure merges into “not reached”: the instruction issued at that step does not match the ground truth.
The last two columns show the two sides of the operating point of ECT: fewer false alarms per mistake-free step, and fewer steps with a mistake flagged.
Plain fine-tuning, which never raises an alarm, confirms more mistake-free steps in time than ECT on both benchmarks (52.1 and 60.2, against 40.8 and 59.0; on QICD so do “+ clean” with 43.3 and tripled clean negatives with 52.5), so completion accuracy is read together with the mistake F1 it leaves.

blocks.en:
For ECT and the variant without paired negatives (seed 0 of each), we logged the probability of “yes” to both questions at every check of the QICD test set and replayed the official per-step loop offline under the thresholded decoding of Appendix D .
The replay matches the official IC-Acc of the thresholded runs (42.0 and 31.1) and approximates their mistake F1 (0.309 and 0.256 against 0.306 and 0.244); 11 and 12 steps are still unconfirmed 60 s after their annotated end, where the log stops, and are counted as confirmed at the next check (ending the recording there instead gives 34.0 and 25.2).
Replacing the mistake probabilities of the variant by those of ECT, with its own completion probabilities, raises its IC-Acc from 31.1 to 40.8, close to the 42.0 of ECT: most of the gain in completion accuracy comes from fewer false alarms. At thresholds of 0.5 on both questions, the closest to greedy decoding, the same exchange raises it from 23.1 to 38.7, against 39.1 for ECT (more steps outlast the log there: 39–54).
Over the checks of mistake-free steps, 7.3% raise an alarm for ECT and 18.3% for the variant, and 26.5% and 40.8% of these steps are voided.
With every alarm removed, ECT still confirms more steps in time than the variant at every completion threshold from 0.1 to 0.6 (at best 61.3 against 54.6), so the two also differ in when they confirm, beyond the threshold; at higher thresholds a growing share of steps outlasts the logged checks.
blocks.zh:
对于ECT和没有配对负数的变体(每个负数的种子为0),我们在QICD测试集的每一次检查中都记录了“是”两个问题的概率,并在附录D的阈值解码下重新播放了每步正式环线。
重播与阈值运行(42.0和31.1)的官方IC-ACC匹配,大致误差为F1(0.309和0.256对0.306和0.244);11和12个步骤在附加说明的结束后60秒仍未证实,其中日志停止,并在下一次检查时被计算为确认(将记录结束为34.0和25.2).
将变体的误差概率由ECT的误差概率取代,加上自身的完成概率,其IC-Acc从31.1提高到40.8,接近ECT的42.0:完成精度的增益大多来自较少的假警报. 在两个问题上的阈值为0.5, 最接近于贪婪的解码, 同样的交换将电算计从23.1升至38.7, 而电算计则为39.1(比那里记录的更远的步骤:39-54)。
在检查无错误步骤时,7.3%的电磁脉冲警报和18.3%的变体,其中26.5%和40.8%的变体被取消。
随着每一个警报被移除,ECT仍然比0.1到0.6(最佳61.3对54.6)的每个完成阈值的变体更及时确认步骤,因此两者在确认时也有所不同,超过了阈值;在更高的阈值,越来越多的步骤超过记录的检查。

blocks.en:
On the fixed validation situations of Tab. S24 , zero-shot Qwen3-VL-2B (one check with the official prompt) answers “yes” to the mistake question with a mean probability of 0.795 where there is no mistake and 0.798 where there is one.
With black frames the first falls to 0.146, and with up to 60 s of elapsed time added (the window padded with copies of its first frame and cut to 240 frames) it stays at 0.729 (0.678 on the windows that receive the full 60 s): the model responds to a person at work, not to the mistake, and its alarms do not grow with elapsed time.
Under the per-step protocol this voids steps from the start: in 83% of the QICD test steps in which the zero-shot model with the memory prompt raises a false alarm, the first one comes at the first check, 5 s in (90% on Ego-MC-Bench), against 0–9% for the four ECT seeds.
blocks.zh:
在Tab.S24的固定验证情况上,零镜头的Qwen3-VL-2B(一次与官方的及时检查)以0.795的无误概率和0.798的无误概率回答错误问题"是".
随着黑框的第一回跌至0.146,加上长达60秒的经过时间(窗口加附其第一回帧的拷贝并剪至240帧),它停留在0.729(0.678在接收满60秒的窗口上):模型对在工作的人作出反应,而不是对错误作出反应,它的警报不会随着经过的时间增长.
在每步协议下,这个步骤从一开始就是空白的:在QICD测试步骤的83%中,带有内存的零射线模型会发出假警报,第一个在第一次检查时出现,5s in(在Ego-MC-Bench上为90%),而4个ECT种子为0–9%.

blocks.en: Appendix G What the feedback says
blocks.zh: 附录G

blocks.en:
The benchmarks credit a detection by its time alone.
To see what the feedback says, we compared 25 randomly drawn detections of thresholded ECT (seed 0) on the QICD test set with the annotated feedback by hand: 9 name the annotated mistake, 3 name it in part, and 13 name a different mistake.
The 13 often use a generic phrase, such as a spill or a wrong amount; the alarm comes at the right time, but the model does not identify what went wrong.
Recall also differs across categories ( Tab. S21 ): mistakes of timing and temperature, which leave little visual trace within a window, are rarely detected.
The detections are timely: the median offset between an alarm and the annotated mistake is − 0.4 -0.4 s on QICD and − 1.0 -1.0 s on Ego-MC-Bench.
blocks.zh:
这些基准本身就足以证明已经发现。
为了了解反馈的内容,我们在QICD测试集中用手对25个随机抽取的阈值ECT(种子0)检测结果进行了比较,并附带注释的反馈: 9命名注释错误,3命名部分,13命名不同的错误.
13型经常使用一个通用短语,如溢出或错误的金额;警报来得正是时候,但模型没有识别出出了什么错误.
召回的类别也不同(Tab.S21):时间和温度的错误,在窗口中留下的视觉痕迹很少,很少被发现.
探测是及时的:警报和注解错误之间的中位偏移是QICD上的0.4-0.4s和Ego-MC-Bench上的1.0-1.0s。

blocks.en:
Figure S5 shows five outcomes of ECT (seed 0, greedy decoding) on the QICD test set, with one step per outcome chosen by a fixed rule before any frame was viewed: the step with the median annotated duration within that outcome.
Over the test set, ECT confirms 98 mistake-free steps on time and confirms 63 others too early (34) or too late (29); it raises a false alarm in 64 mistake-free steps; it alarms on time in 59 steps with a mistake and stays silent in 147. The remaining 30 steps with a mistake receive alarms only outside the tolerance. Thirteen mistake-free steps have no scored decision (11 end-of-video segments with empty annotated instructions and two steps after the last prediction); they remain in the official IC denominator.
In the failure cases, ECT alarms 5 s after the annotated end of a mistake-free step (C), confirms 6 s after an annotated mistake without saying anything (D), and confirms 126 s after the annotated end of a step (E).
On case A, the model trained without paired negatives confirms 19 s early. On case B, it alarms seven times, compared with three alarms from ECT.

In a further run (ECT seed 0, QICD test set) every check instead receives the frames of the same instruction step in another recording of the same recipe, aligned at the step start.
Of the 193 steps that have such a counterpart, 37 (in 17 videos) are free of mistakes in both recordings, and 35 of these are confirmed.

它们的确认时间与模型在r=0.38 r=0.38(95%间隔[0.11,0.69][0.11,0.69])的录音中所看到的步骤的持续时间有关,与原始记录在r=0.21 r=0.21([−0.11,0.47] [-0.11,0.47])中的持续时间有关;步骤差别不大([−0.24,0.72] [-0.24,0.72])。

blocks.en:
On 411 of these situations we changed only the time stamps that the processor writes between the frames, doubling or halving every stamp; the pixels, the number of frames and the prompt are unchanged.
ECT (seed 0) barely responds: its AUROC is 0.945, 0.942 and 0.943 for completion and 0.841, 0.820 and 0.846 for mistakes with the original, doubled and halved stamps, and its probability of “yes” moves by 0.013–0.025 on average.
The mistake AUROC of the variant without paired negatives (seed 0) falls from 0.971 to 0.79–0.80 and that of plain fine-tuning from 0.961 to 0.60–0.61; the recipe of ECT trained and tested on black frames ( Appendix C ), which separates these situations at 0.920 for completion and 0.958 for mistakes without seeing any video, falls to 0.74–0.77 and 0.59–0.69.
Doubling and halving the stamps both raise the probability of “yes” on silent situations, by 0.14–0.16 for the variant without paired negatives, while that of ECT changes by at most 0.01: the variant reacts to stamps unlike those of training rather than reading their value. With rescaled stamps its mistake AUROC is no longer above that of ECT (ECT minus the variant − 0.130 -0.130 [ − 0.190 , − 0.079 ] [-0.190,-0.079] with the original stamps, + 0.025 +0.025 [ − 0.031 , + 0.080 ] [-0.031,+0.080] doubled and + 0.042 +0.042 [ − 0.011 , + 0.100 ] [-0.011,+0.100] halved; 95% intervals over videos).
ECT does use how long a step usually takes: on the QICD test set its confirmation time follows the median training duration of the instruction beyond the duration of the step itself (partial correlation of log times 0.55–0.63 over four seeds, 0.48–0.54 without paired negatives, 0.63–0.64 for the two black-frame models). Its training pairs leave this cue in place: re-simulated from the annotations, the instruction’s typical duration (from the other training videos) separates the two sides of 80–81% of the completion pairs and 58–59% of the mistake pairs, although elapsed time alone ties them.
On the time-matched pairs, elapsed time alone scores 0.5, the instruction’s typical duration 0.65 and 0.54, and the recipe trained on black frames 0.62–0.64 and 0.54–0.56; ECT uses such information too, but scores 0.90–0.92 and 0.75–0.77 ( Appendix E ), and in this probe it does not respond to the time stamps.
blocks.zh:
在其中的411种情况下,我们只更改了处理器在帧之间所写的时间戳,将每张邮票翻倍或减半;像素,帧数和提示不变.
ECT(种子0)几乎没有反应:它的AUROC是0.945、0.942和0.943完成,0.841、0.820和0.846是使用原邮票、翻一番和减半的错误,它的 " 是 " 移动的概率平均为0.013-0.025。
变体无配对负数(种子0)的AUROC错误从0.971降至0.79-0.80,纯微调从0.961降至0.60-0.61;在黑框上训练和测试的ECT配方(附录C)将这些情况分为0.920完成和0.958错误,没有看到任何视频。
邮票的翻倍和减半,都提高了沉默情况下 " 是 " 的概率,对于无对负数的变体,则增加了0.14-0.16,而ECT的变体则增加了0.01:变体对邮票的反应不同于训练邮票,而不是读取其价值。 由于邮票的缩放调整,其误差已超过ECT(ECT减去变式−0.130-0.130[−0.190,−0.079] [-0.190,−0.079],原邮票,+0.025+0.025[−0.031,+0.080]加倍,+0.042+0.042[−0.011,+0.100]减半;视频间隔95%。
ECT的确使用一个步骤通常需要多长时间:在QICD测试上,它的确认时间按照指令在步骤本身持续时间之后的中位训练时间(在四个种子上,log乘以0.55–0.63,0.48–0.54不配对负数,两个黑框型号0.63–0.64的部分相关性). 它的训练配对留下了这个提示:从说明中重新模拟出来,教导的典型持续时间(从其他训练录像中)将80-81%的完成配对和58-59 %的错配对的两边分隔开来,尽管仅仅经过一段时间就将它们联系在一起。
在时间匹配的对子上,仅经过时间就得分0.5分,指示的典型持续时间为0.65分和0.54分,以及经过黑框0.62–0.64分和0.54–0.56分训练的食谱;ECT也使用这种信息,但得分0.90–0.92分和0.75–0.77分(附录E),在这个探测中,它不响应时间戳.

blocks.en: Appendix J Training data and recipe
blocks.zh: 附录J 培训数据和方法

blocks.en:
From the 209 training videos we build 18,406 situations (seed 0): 1,938 mistake, 4,563 success, 6,315 silence, 363 shifted, 4,068 notdone and 1,159 clean.
Mistake situations are placed at the annotated feedback time and 5 and 10 s later, success situations at the step end and 5 s later, and silence situations every 20 s inside a step, away from any annotated event.
A shifted situation is a check before an annotated mistake and outside its tolerance window, answered “NO”.
Each training step draws 8 situations by kind with fixed weights: mistake 0.25, success 0.20, silence, notdone and clean 0.15 each, and shifted 0.10.
blocks.zh:
从我们制作的209个训练视频中,有18 406个情况(种子0):1 938个错误、4 563个成功、6 315个沉默、363个转变、4 068个非音和1 159个干净。
错误情况在附加说明的反馈时间和5点及10点之后处理,成功情况在步骤结束时和5点之后处理,每20点之内就有一个沉默情况,远离任何附加说明的事件。
情况发生转变是在附加说明的错误之前以及在容忍的窗口之外进行核对,回答“否”。
每个训练步骤按种类抽取8种情况,有固定的权重:错误0.25,成功0.20,沉默,调头和清理0.15,各移0.10.

blocks.en:
We train LoRA adapters of rank 64 on Qwen3-VL-2B with AdamW, a learning rate of 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} and cross-entropy on the answer tokens for 2,400 steps (19,200 situations, about one epoch). A run takes about 15 hours on one A100: five later runs of the same pipeline took 13.6–16.8 hours; the four seeds of ECT shared their GPUs with other jobs and took 18.0–28.6 hours of wall-clock time, seed 3 on an A100-80GB (peak memory 9.1 GiB).
Seed 0 of “+ notdone” was interrupted and resumed from its checkpoint at step 2,300.
blocks.zh:
我们用 AdamW 在 Quen3-VL-2B 上训练64 级的 LORA适配器, 学习率为 2× 10 − 4 2\times 10× 4 → 4), 在答题符号上交叉交替, 共2 400步(19 200次情况,大约一个时代)。 一个A100的运行需要约15小时:同一管道的5次后期运行需要13.6–16.8小时;ECT的4个种子与其他工作共享他们的GPU,并需要18.0–28.6小时的壁时时间,A100–80GB上的3号种子(峰值记忆9.1 GiB).
“+ Notdone”的种子0被中断,在2 300步从检查站恢复。

blocks.en:
The rows of the ablation differ from ECT as follows. No paired negatives differs in the negatives alone: the situations are built in the same way, the notdone and clean situations are removed, and the weights of the remaining kinds are renormalized (mistake 0.36, success 0.29, silence 0.21, shifted 0.14). No negatives, re-balanced sampling uses the same situations as the previous variant with other weights (silence 0.40, success 0.25, mistake 0.25, shifted 0.10), which brings the share of “YES” answers to the mistake question close to that of ECT. Plain fine-tuning is an earlier recipe and differs in four ways: one mistake situation per annotated mistake and one success situation per step (9,632 situations: 6,315 silence, 2,303 success, 652 mistake, 362 shifted); uniform sampling over situations, so that mistakes make up about 7% of the draws; the other question asked on 30% of the positive situations instead of 20%; and no paired negatives.
It is trained for two epochs (2,408 steps) with the same model and optimizer.
With so few positive examples for the mistake question it learns never to raise an alarm, which under the official scoring voids no step and gives it the highest completion accuracy; the gap between it and ECT cannot be attributed to the negatives.
blocks.zh:
衰减的行与ECT不同如下. 单是负数没有成对的负数不同:情况建构方式相同,调出 Notdone和干净的情况,剩余种类的重量重新正常化(误差0.36,成功0.29,沉默0.21,转移0.14). 没有负数,重新平衡的采样使用与其他加权数相同的情况(沉默0.40,成功0.25,错误0.25,转移0.10),这使得“YES”答错问题的比例接近ECT。 普通的微调是较早的配方,在四个方面有不同:每个注解错误一个错误情况,每个步骤一个成功情况(9,632个情况:6,315个沉默,2,303个成功,652个错误,362个转变);对情况进行统一的抽样,这样错误占抽取的7%左右;另一个问题则问30%的正面情况,而不是20%;没有对负数。
它为两个时代(2,408步)进行训练,采用相同的模型和优化器.
对于错误问题,它很少有正面的例子,它学会了永远不引起警报,在官方评分下,警告不会使任何步骤无效,并给予它最高的完成精确度;它和ECT之间的差距不能归咎于负数.

blocks.en:
The training, validation and test videos of QICD Advanced Planning (209, 57 and 36) are disjoint, and Ego-MC-Bench was recorded separately.
All 18 recipes of the QICD test set occur in the training split, by design of the benchmark; 2 of the 562 instructions of Ego-MC-Bench do.
A classifier that reads only the instruction text separates the labels of our training situations with an AUROC of 0.553.
The same classifier reaches 0.918 when the synthetic counterfactual pairs of Bhattacharyya et al. [11] are mixed in, because their rewritten instructions differ in wording from the original ones; this is one reason why we train on QICD alone.
A model fine-tuned with these pairs shows the shortcut directly: when the leading “Now” is removed from the instruction and the frames are left unchanged, its mean probability of “yes” to the mistake question rises from 0.017 by 0.73 over 240 validation situations (by at least 0.67 for each kind of situation), whereas the zero-shot model and a model trained on QICD alone change by 0.001.
Elapsed time separates the labels with an AUROC of 0.57–0.60 for the completion question and 0.55–0.56 for the mistake question over all training situations, and with 0.541 and 0.606 over the positives and their paired negatives.
blocks.zh:
QICD高级规划(209,57和36)的培训,验证和测试视频是脱节的,Ego-MC-Bench单独录制.
QICD测试集的所有18种食谱都发生在训练分拆中,通过基准设计;在Ego-MC-Bench do的562指令中,有2种.
仅阅读指令文本的分类员将我们训练情况的标签与0.553的AUROC分开。
当Bhattacharyya等人合成反事实对时,同一分类器达到0.918。 [11]是混杂的,因为他们的重写指令在措辞上与原始指令不同;这就是我们单独在QICD上训练的原因之一.
与这些对齐进行微调的模型直接显示捷径:当领先的“现在”从指令中删除而框则保持不变时,其“是”错误问题的平均概率从0.017上升0.73,超过240个验证情况(每种情况至少0.67),而零镜头模型和只接受过QICD训练的模型则在0.001之前有所改变。
耗时将标签分开,AUROC的完成问题为0.57-0.60,错误问题为0.55-0.56,所有训练情况为0.541和0.606。
